legendary.name: Lair Actions
legendary.text:
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the dragon takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects:
• The dragon creates fog as though it had cast the fog cloud spell. The fog lasts until initiative count 20 on the next round.
• A thunderclap originates at a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within a 20-foot radius centered on that point must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (1d10) thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Regional Effects
legendary.text:
The region containing a legendary bronze dragon's lair is warped by the dragon's magic.
• Once per day, the dragon can alter the weather in a 6-mile radius centered on its lair. The dragon doesn't need to be outdoors; otherwise the effect is identical to the control weather spell.
• Underwater plants within 6 miles of the dragon's lair take on dazzlingly brilliant hues.
• Within its lair, the dragon can set illusory sounds, such as soft music and strange echoes, so that they can be heard in various parts of the lair.
If the dragon dies, changed weather reverts to normal, as described in the spell, and the other effects fade in 1d10 days.

monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 241

monster.name: Undead Bulette

trait.name: Standing Leap
trait.text: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Deadly Leap
action.text: If the bulette jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the bulette's space.

monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 90

monster.name: Undead Shambling Mound

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
trait.text: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Engulf
action.text:
The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 142

monster.name: Valtagar Steelshadow
monster.resist: damage from spells; nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing (from stoneskin), poison

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Valtagar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: Valtagar has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

trait.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
trait.text: For 1 minute, Valtagar magically increases in size, along with anything they are wearing or carrying. While enlarged, Valtagar is Large, doubles their damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If Valtagar lacks the room to become Large, they attain the maximum size possible in the space available.

trait.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
trait.text: Valtagar magically turns invisible until they attack, cast a spell, or use their Enlarge, or until their concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment Valtagar wears or carries is invisible with them.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Variant: Familiars
action.text: Any spellcaster that can cast the find familiar spell (such as an archmage or mage) is likely to have a familiar. The familiar can be one of the creatures described in the spell (see the Player's Handbook) or some other Tiny monster, such as a crawling claw, imp, pseudodragon, or quasit.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Valtagar is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Valtagar can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
• At will: disguise self, invisibility.
• Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp • 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, mage armor*, magic missile • 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step • 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fly, lightning bolt • 4th level (3 slots): Otiluke's Resilient Sphere, fire shield, stoneskin* • 5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, scrying, wall of force • 6th level (1 slots): globe of invulnerability • 7th level (1 slots): teleport • 8th level (1 slots): mind blank* • 9th level (1 slots): time stop
*Valtagar casts these spells on itself before combat.

monster.name: Werebat
monster.immune: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text: The werebat can use its action to polymorph into a Medium bat-humanoid hybrid, or into a Large giant bat, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Echolocation (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
trait.text: The werebat has blindsight out to a range of 60 feet as long as it's not deafened.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
trait.text: The werebat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Nimble Escape (Humanoid Form Only)
trait.text: The werebat can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, the werebat has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: In humanoid form, the werebat makes two scimitar attacks or two shortbow attacks. In hybrid form, it can make one bite attack and one scimitar attack.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the werebat gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werebat lycanthropy.

action.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

monster.description:
A werebat is a humanoid afflicted with a rare form of lycanthropy that enables it to transform into a giant bat or a bat-humanoid hybrid. (See the Monster Manual for more information onlycanthropy.) Most werebats are of goblin stock.
Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 317

monster.name: Wooden Donkey

trait.name: Beast of Burden
trait.text: The donkey is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
trait.text: The donkey has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Hooves
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 84

monster.name: Wyllow
monster.languages: Druidic plus any two languages, Elvish

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Wyllow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Wyllow to sleep.

trait.name: Mask of the Wild
trait.text: Wyllow can attempt to hide even when they are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

action.name: Scimitar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
action.text:
Wyllow magically polymorphs into a beast or elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 9 hours. Wyllow can choose whether its equipment falls to the ground, melds with its new form, or is worn by the new form. Wyllow reverts to its true form if it dies or falls unconscious. Wyllow can revert to its true form using a bonus action on its turn.
While in a new form, Wyllow retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. It can cast its spells with verbal or somatic components in its new form.
The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Wyllow is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, mending, poison spray, produce flame • 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, entangle, faerie fire, speak with animals • 2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, beast sense, hold person • 3rd level (3 slots): conjure animals, meld into stone, water breathing • 4th level (3 slots): dominate beast, locate creature, stoneskin, wall of fire • 5th level (3 slots): commune with nature, mass cure wounds, tree stride • 6th level (1 slots): heal, heroes' feast, sunbeam • 7th level (1 slots): fire storm • 8th level (1 slots): animal shapes • 9th level (1 slots): foresight

monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 70

monster.name: Zalthar Shadowdusk

trait.name: Special Equipment
trait.text: Zalthar wields a nine lives stealer longsword with 5 charges remaining.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Zalthar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Marshal Undead
trait.text: Unless Zalthar is incapacitated, it and undead creatures of its choice within 60 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against features that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Zalthar makes three longsword attacks.

action.name: Nine Lives Stealer Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage, or 12 (1d10 + 7) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Hellfire Orb (1/Day)
action.text: Zalthar hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Zalthar adds 6 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Zalthar must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Zalthar is a 19th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following paladin spells prepared:
• 1st level (4 slots): command, compelled duel, searing smite • 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, magic weapon • 3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, elemental weapon • 4th level (3 slots): locate creature, staggering smite • 5th level (2 slots): destructive wave (necrotic)

monster.spells: command, compelled duel, searing smite, hold person, magic weapon, dispel magic, elemental weapon, locate creature, staggering smite, destructive wave
monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 286

monster.name: Zorak Lightdrinker
monster.resist: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: Augrek has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text:
If Zorak isn't in sunlight or running water, he can use his action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form.
While in bat form, Zorak can't speak, his walking speed is 5 feet, and he has a flying speed of 30 feet. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are unchanged. Anything he is wearing transforms with it, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies.
While in mist form, Zorak can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and he can't pass through water. He has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Zorak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
trait.text:
When he drops to 0 hit points outside his resting place, Zorak transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that he isn't in sunlight or running water. If he can't transform, he is destroyed.
While he has 0 hit points in mist form, he can't revert to his vampire form, and he must reach his resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in his resting place, he reverts to his vampire form. He is then paralyzed until he regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in his resting place with 0 hit points, he regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Zorak regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Zorak takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Zorak's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: Zorak can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
trait.text:
Zorak has the following flaws:
Forbiddance: Zorak can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water: Zorak takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Zorak's heart while Zorak is incapacitated in his resting place, Zorak is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity: Zorak takes 20 radiant damage when he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Zorak makes two attacks with his dwarven thrower, only one of which can be a ranged attack.

action.name: Dwarven Thrower
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, or 12 (1d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack. On a ranged attack that hits, the hammer deals an extra 1d8 bludgeoning damage (2d8 if the target is a giant). Hit or Miss: If thrown, the weapon flies back to Zorak's hand after the attack.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
action.text: Zorak makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, Zorak can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by Zorak, incapacitated, or restrained. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Zorak regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces his hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Zorak's control.

action.name: Charm
action.text:
Zorak targets one humanoid he can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Zorak, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by Zorak. The charmed target regards Zorak as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Zorak's control, it takes Zorak's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Zorak's bite attack.
Each time Zorak or Zorak's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Zorak is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
action.text: Zorak magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats or swarm of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Zorak can call 3d6 wolf instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Zorak and obeying his spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Zorak dies, or until Zorak dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.text: Zorak can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Zorak regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Move
legendary.text: Zorak moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary.text: Zorak makes one unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Zorak makes one bite attack.

legendary.name: Regional Effects
legendary.text:
The region surrounding a vampire's lair is warped by the creature's unnatural presence, creating any of the following effects:
• There's a noticeable increase in the populations of bats, rats, and wolves in the region.
• Plants within 500 feet of the lair wither, and their stems and branches become twisted and thorny.
• Shadows cast within 500 feet of the lair seem abnormally gaunt and sometimes move as though alive.
• A creeping fog clings to the ground within 500 feet of the vampire's lair. The fog occasionally takes eerie forms, such as grasping claws and writhing serpents.
If the vampire is destroyed, these effects end after 2d6 days.

monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 204

monster.resist: damage from spells; nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing (from stoneskin)

trait.text: Zox has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
trait.text: Zox has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Variant: Familiars

Zox is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Zox can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

• Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp • 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, mage armor*, magic missile • 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step • 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fly, lightning bolt • 4th level (3 slots): confusion, fire shield, stoneskin* • 5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, scrying, wall of force • 6th level (1 slots): globe of invulnerability • 7th level (1 slots): teleport • 8th level (1 slots): mind blank* • 9th level (1 slots): time stop
*Zox casts these spells on itself before combat.

monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 176

monster.name: Zress Orlezziir

trait.name: Battle Command
trait.text: As a bonus action, Zress targets one ally he can see within 30 feet of him. If the target can see or hear Zress, the target can use its reaction to make one melee attack or to take the Dodge or Hide action.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Zress has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Zress to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Zress has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Zress makes three attacks: two with his scimitar and one with his whip or his hand crossbow.

action.name: Scimitar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

action.name: Whip
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.
If the target is an ally, it has advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
action.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour.
If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target regains consciousness if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Zress adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Zress must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Zress's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: dancing lights • 1/Day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)

monster.spells: dancing lights, darkness, faerie fire, levitate
monster.description: Source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p. 136

monster.name: Demogorgon (monstrosity)

trait.name: Keen Smell
trait.text: The Demogorgon (monstrosity) has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
trait.text: The Demogorgon (monstrosity) has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: The Demogorgon (monstrosity) regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the Demogorgon (monstrosity) takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the Demogorgon (monstrosity)'s next turn. The Demogorgon (monstrosity) dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The Demogorgon (monstrosity) makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

monster.description: Source: Hunt for the Thessalhydra p. 36

monster.name: Thessalhydra

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The thessalhydra makes one maw attack and one Flurry of Bites.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage.

action.name: Maw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage.

action.name: Tail Pincer
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled.
As an action, the target can escape the grapple by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (its choice). Until this grapple ends, the thessalhydra can't use its tail pincer.

action.name: Acid Saliva (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The thessalhydra spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.text: The monstrosity can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The monstrosity regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
legendary.text: The thessalhydra makes a Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
legendary.text: The thessalhydra makes a tail pincer attack.

monster.description:
The thessalhydra is a strange and terrible creature with eight heads surrounding a large, circular mouth rimmed with jagged teeth. Its maw drips with acid, and its tail ends with a pair of sharp pincers. The thessalhydra is gluttonous and damaging to any environment.
Source: Hunt for the Thessalhydra p. 41, Infernal Machine Rebuild

monster.name: Amphisbaena (monstrosity)

trait.name: Two Heads
trait.text: The Amphisbaena (monstrosity) has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The Amphisbaena (monstrosity) makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 230, Mythic Odysseys of Theros

monster.name: Barnacle Bess

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: Bess can breathe air and water.

action.name: Claw
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11).
Bess has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 220

monster.name: Bullywug Croaker

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The croaker can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
trait.text: The croaker can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

trait.name: Standing Leap
trait.text: The croaker's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
trait.text: The croaker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Spear
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Glaaar-pat (3/Day)
action.text: The croaker sings a song of marshy doom. Each chosen creature within 30 feet of the croaker that can hear the song must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw also has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Rooooo-glog (1/Day)
action.text: The croaker sings an ode to an elder froghemoth. Each bullywug within 30 feet of the croaker that can hear the song gains 10 temporary hit points.

monster.description:
Some bullywugs are born with the ability to weave magic into their songs. These rare specimens are raised in protected enclaves where they are taught to use their magic to both heal and harm. As demonstrated in Danger at Dunwater, they are among the most pompous of bullywugs.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 232

monster.name: Bullywug Royal

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The royal can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Brute
trait.text: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the royal hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Frog Rider
trait.text: The royal has advantage on melee attacks made while riding a frog mount.

trait.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
trait.text: The royal can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

trait.name: Standing Leap
trait.text: The royal's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
trait.text: The royal has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The royal makes two attacks: one with its royal spear and one with its bite.

action.name: Royal Spear
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Croaked Decree (1/Day)
action.text: The royal makes a loud pronouncement. Each bullywug within 60 feet of the royal that can hear the pronouncement has advantage on its next attack roll.

monster.description:
The largest and most intelligent bullywugs invariably end up leading their kind. These sneering specimens dress in robes made from leather, rough cloth, and bits of marsh plants. As seen in Danger at Dunwater, a bullywug royal is often accompanied by and mounted astride a giant toad.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 232

monster.name: Captain Xendros

trait.name: Divine Eminence
trait.text: As a bonus action, Xendros can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Xendros expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

action.name: Mace
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Xendros is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Xendros has the following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy • 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary • 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon • 3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Xendros's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). Xendros can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: thaumaturgy • 1/Day each: darkness, hellish rebuke

monster.spells: light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy, cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary, lesser restoration, spiritual weapon, dispel magic, spirit guardians, thaumaturgy, darkness, hellish rebuke
monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 14

monster.name: Drowned Ascetic
monster.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bottom Treader
trait.text: The drowned ascetic cannot swim, and it sinks to the bottom of any body of water. It takes no penalties to its movement or attacks underwater. It is immune to the effects of being underwater at a depth greater than 100 feet.

trait.name: Bound Together
trait.text: The drowned ascetic shares its mind with every other drowned one within 1 mile of it, and can communicate its thoughts and observations to them instantaneously and without limitation.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
trait.text: If damage reduces the drowned ascetic to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned ascetic drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The drowned ascetic makes three unarmed strikes.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

reaction.name: Dexterous Target
reaction.text: The drowned ascetic adds 3 to its AC against one ranged attack that would hit it. To do so, the drowned ascetic must see the attacker.

monster.description:
Dressed in tattered robes, its fists wrapped in long rib bons of rotting cloth, the drowned ascetic moves with alarming speed for an undead creature. This martial artist, rising from the ocean in Tammeraut's Fate, retains its fighting reflexes despite its rotting flesh.
Bluerot: This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in 1d4 hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by 1d4 each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.
At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 233, Locathah Rising

monster.name: Drowned Assassin
monster.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bottom Treader
trait.text: The drowned assassin cannot swim, and it sinks to the bottom of any body of water. It takes no penalties to its movement or attacks underwater. It is immune to the effects of being underwater at a depth greater than 100 feet.

trait.name: Bound Together
trait.text: The drowned assassin shares its mind with every other drowned one within 1 mile of it, and can communicate its thoughts and observations to them instantaneously and without limitation.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
trait.text: If damage reduces the drowned assassin to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned assassin drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The drowned assassin makes two hand crossbow attacks or two dagger attacks. It can then take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

action.name: Reveal (1/Day)
action.text: The drowned assassin removes its mask, revealing its rotting face. Each creature of the assassin's choice within 30 feet of it that can see the assassin must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

monster.description:
The drowned assassin stalks and kills in a grim pantomime of its former occupation. Sneaking from shadow to shadow, and appearing in the undead assault of Tammeraut's Fate, it aims its barnacle-encrusted hand crossbow with deadly precision. Hidden behind a simple driftwood mask, this creature's face causes terror in mortal hearts when exposed.
Bluerot: This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in 1d4 hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by 1d4 each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.
At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 234, Locathah Rising

monster.name: Drowned Blade
monster.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bottom Treader
trait.text: The drowned blade cannot swim, and it sinks to the bottom of any body of water. It takes no penalties to its movement or attacks underwater. It is immune to the effects of being underwater at a depth greater than 100 feet.

trait.name: Bound Together
trait.text: The drowned blade shares its mind with every other drowned one within 1 mile of it, and can communicate its thoughts and observations to them instantaneously and without limitation.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
trait.text: If damage reduces the drowned blade to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned blade drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The drowned blade makes two rusted longsword attacks.

action.name: Rusted Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

monster.description:
Assaulting the hermitage in Tammeraut's Fate, this barnacle-encrusted undead warrior fights with surprising cunning. Starfish cling to its wispy beard, and its evil rage is visible in its bloated gray eyes.
Bluerot: This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in 1d4 hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by 1d4 each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.
At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 235, Locathah Rising

monster.name: Drowned Master
monster.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bound Together
trait.text: The drowned master shares its mind with every other drowned one within 1 mile of it, and can communicate its thoughts and observations to them instantaneously and without limitation.

trait.name: Cold Aura
trait.text:
At the start of each of the drowned master's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.
A creature that touches the drowned master or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
trait.text: If damage reduces the drowned master to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned master drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The drowned master makes two attacks: one with its greatsword and one with its Life-Draining Tentacle.

action.name: Greatsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

action.name: Life-Draining Tentacle
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. On a failed save, the target also contracts bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

action.name: Necrotic Ink (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The drowned master discharges foul ink in front of itself in a 30-foot cone. Each creature caught in the ink must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw is blinded until the end of its next turn and contracts bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

monster.description:
This waterlogged undead, bound to the Pit of Hatred in Tammeraut's Fate, hovers menacingly over the bones of its victims. Its torso, arms, and head retain their former shapes, but its legs have split into shadowy tentacles. The drowned master is tethered to a source of powerful magic that prevents it from traveling far. It commands other drowned ones, compelling them to serve as agents in its dark plots.
Bluerot: This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in 1d4 hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by 1d4 each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.
At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 235, Locathah Rising

monster.name: Fish

trait.name: Water Breathing
trait.text: The fish can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 224

monster.name: Giant Coral Snake

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a failed save, the target begins to hallucinate and is afflicted with a dmg|8|madness). The effect lasts 10 minutes.

monster.description:
Comfortable on land or in water, these brilliantly colored snakes are renowned for their potent and hallucinogenic venom. They are most often found in coastal caves. In the abandoned chambers of the hermitage in Tammeraut's Fate, these giant serpents feed on any creature that crosses their path.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 236

monster.name: Giant Sea Eel

trait.name: Water Breathing
trait.text: The eel can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.description:
Snaking predators lurking in the dark waters of the ocean, these kelp-colored beasts serve as guards and mounts for the locathah (including those found in Danger at Dunwater).
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 237

monster.name: Giant White Moray Eel

trait.name: Water Breathing
trait.text: The eel can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 216

monster.name: Harpy Matriarch

trait.name: Luring Maestro
trait.text: While within 60 feet of the matriarch, creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the matriarch's Luring Song.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The matriarch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The matriarch makes two claws attacks.

action.name: Claws
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Fleeting Form
action.text: The matriarch can magically disguise itself to resemble a humanoid of roughly similar size and shape for up to 1 hour. It can revert to its true form as a bonus action. This illusion does not hold up to close scrutiny.

action.name: Luring Song
action.text:
The matriarch sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the matriarch that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The matriarch must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the matriarch is incapacitated.
While charmed by the matriarch, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the matriarch, the target must move on its turn toward the matriarch by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the matriarch, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this matriarch's song for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Visage of Desire (1/Day)
action.text: The matriarch projects a vision into the minds of creatures within 30 feet of it that aren't constructs or undead, showing each creature achieving whatever it most desires. An affected creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

monster.description:
Happy to watch its flock squabble over carrion in Tammeraut's Fate, this gray-feathered matron of the harpies is surrounded by a cloud of magical spirits resembling skeletal seabirds.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 237

monster.name: Juvenile Kraken
monster.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, Primordial, telepathy 60 ft. but can't speak
monster.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The kraken can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Freedom of Movement
trait.text: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The kraken makes two tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of Fling.

action.name: Bite
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage.
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. One Medium or two smaller creatures can be swallowed at the same time.

If the kraken takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20).
Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Fling
action.text: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Lightning Strike
action.text: The kraken magically create a bolt of lightning, which can strike a target the kraken can see within 90 feet of it. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.text: The monstrosity (titan) can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The monstrosity (titan) regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tentacle Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The kraken makes one tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Fling
legendary.text: The kraken uses Fling.

legendary.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 40-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

monster.description:
Hidden in a deep, dark underwater pit near the Styes, this creature bears the mark of the dark god Tharizdun's madness. Becoming more independent every day, it dreams of freeing itself from its aboleth tenders and wreaking its own foul will upon the seas.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 238

monster.name: Koalinth

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The koalinth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
trait.text: Once per turn, the koalinth can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the koalinth that isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Trident
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monster.description:
The koalinth, found in Danger at Dunwater, are martial and aggressive aquatic hobgoblins, with brightly colored faces and functional gills. They are known for their ferocity, and for their hatred of elves.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 239

monster.name: Koalinth Sergeant

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The koalinth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
trait.text: Once per turn, the sergeant can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the sergeant that isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The sergeant makes two melee attacks with its trident.

action.name: Trident
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Hooked Net
action.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is restrained.
A creature can use its action to make a DC 12 Strength check to free itself or another creature in a hooked net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 12) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

reaction.name: Spear the Helpless (2/Day)
reaction.text: Whenever a creature within 30 feet of the sergeant becomes restrained, the sergeant can move its speed toward the restrained creature. If the sergeant ends its move within reach of the restrained creature, it can make a melee attack against it.

monster.description:
These fierce koalinths lead special missions for their people, such as the diplomatic envoy encountered in Danger at Dunwater. A koalinth sergeant focuses its ire on the most significant threats on the battlefield, then eliminates those threats one by one.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 239

monster.name: Krell Grohlg
monster.languages: Druidic plus any two languages, Orc

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
trait.text: When reduced to 0 hit points, Krell drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until they finish a long rest).

trait.name: Savage Attacks
trait.text: When they score a critical hit, Krell can roll one of the weapon's damage dice and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

action.name: Quarterstaff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh or if wielded with two hands.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Krell is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh • 1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave • 2nd level (3 slots): flaming sphere, barkskin

monster.spells: druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh, entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave, flaming sphere, barkskin
monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 92

monster.name: Kysh

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: Kysh can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Emissary of the Sea
trait.text: Kysh can communicate simple ideas with amphibious and water-breathing beasts. They understand the meaning of his words, but he cannot understand them in return.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Kysh makes two melee attacks with his spear.

action.name: Spear
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text: Kysh's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He can cast the following spell, requiring only verbal components: • 1/Day: fog cloud

monster.spells: fog cloud
monster.description:
A prisoner of the sahuagin in The Final Enemy, Kysh is a defender of the deep sea realms who is ready to join the party in their struggle. Tritons are folk of the Elemental Plane of Water who journeyed to the Material Plane to watch over the dark places of the ocean depths. They stand guard over portals, deep sea chasms, and other places where foul monsters might emerge. When such threats appear, the tritons take up arms to drive them from the world.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 240

monster.name: Living Iron Statue
monster.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

trait.name: Immutable Form
trait.text: The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The statue makes two attacks: one with its blade and one with its hammer.

action.name: Blade
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Hammer
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Whirl (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The statue can use its action to spin at the waist, targeting creatures of its choice within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.description:
This squat, solid-looking statue, currently guarding the evil cult's treasure in Isle of the Abbey, is made from pure iron. Its hands are shaped into deadly weapons.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 241

monster.name: Lizardfolk Commoner

trait.name: Hold Breath
trait.text: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.description:
These lizardfolk, found wandering the halls in Danger at Dunwater, are just as fierce as their armed kin, and can equip themselves with weapons and shields if such are available.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 241

monster.name: Lizardfolk Render

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
trait.text: The render has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Hold Breath
trait.text: The render can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The render makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its bite.

action.name: Claws
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Rend the Field (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The render makes a claw attack against each creature of its choice within 10 feet of it. A creature hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

monster.description:
Filled with the primal magic of Semuanya, the lizardfolk render undergoes terrifying changes during a dayslong ritual performed by a shaman. As seen in Danger at Dunwater, the render's claws grow long and hard as steel, its frame enlarges, and its temperament becomes even more ferocious.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 241, Essentials Kit: Storm Lord's Wrath, Infernal Machine Rebuild

monster.name: Lizardfolk Scaleshield

trait.name: Hold Breath
trait.text: The scaleshield can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The scaleshield makes two melee attacks, each one with a different weapon.

action.name: Morningstar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Spiked Shield
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Shield Block
reaction.text: If an ally within 5 feet of the scaleshield is hit by an attack, the scaleshield can reduce that attack's damage by half.

monster.description:
Serving as the elite warriors and officers of a lizardfolk clan, these robust creatures wear thick armor made from crocodile scales and metal. Trained in martial weapons and advanced combat tactics, they are found protecting lizardfolk lairs such as the one in Danger at Dunwater.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 242

monster.name: Lizardfolk Subchief

trait.name: Hold Breath
trait.text: The subchief can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Tooth Dagger
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Jaws of Semuanya (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The subchief invokes the primal magic of Semuanya, summoning a spectral maw around a target it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw is also frightened until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
The subchief is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy • 1st level (4 slots): command, guiding bolt, purify food and drink • 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, lesser restoration, silence • 3rd level (2 slots): bestow curse, dispel magic

monster.spells: light, sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy, command, guiding bolt, purify food and drink, hold person, lesser restoration, silence, bestow curse, dispel magic
monster.description:
The lizardfolk subchief (seen in Danger at Dunwater) is a devout priest of Semuanya, pursuing the worship of its god in a manner similar to a cleric. It wields a dagger crafted of a massive crocodile tooth blessed by Semuanya, representing the subchief's prowess in both battle and piety.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 242, Essentials Kit: Storm Lord's Wrath

monster.name: Locathah

trait.name: Leviathan Will
trait.text: The locathah has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or put to sleep.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
trait.text: The locathah can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The locathah makes two melee attacks with its spear.

action.name: Spear
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands.

monster.description:
These resilient and proud fish-folk (found in Danger at Dunwater) have endured war, slavery, and mistreatment at the hands of other aquatic creatures. They dwell in submerged tribal communities along seacoasts, and hunt both above and below the water.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 243, Infernal Machine Rebuild

monster.name: Locathah Hunter

trait.name: Leviathan Will
trait.text: The hunter has advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that control its actions.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
trait.text: The hunter can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The hunter makes two attacks with its envenomed crossbow.

action.name: Envenomed Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Club
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

monster.description:
The far-ranging locathah hunter is trained in tracking and stalking prey on land and in water. They often serve as leaders to small bands of locathah or emissaries for their people (such as the hunter found in Danger at Dunwater). Their colorful, poisoned, and fast-loading crossbows rarely miss a target.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 243

monster.name: Master Refrum

trait.name: Divine Eminence
trait.text: As a bonus action, Refrum can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Refrum expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

action.name: Mace
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Refrum is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Refrum has the following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy • 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary • 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon • 3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians

monster.spells: light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy, cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary, lesser restoration, spiritual weapon, dispel magic, spirit guardians
monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 165

monster.name: Maw of Sekolah

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
trait.text: If the maw of Sekolah fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Water Breathing
trait.text: The maw of Sekolah can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The maw of Sekolah makes one attack with its bite and one attack with its tail smash.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail Smash
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.text: The monstrosity can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The monstrosity regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
legendary.text: The maw of Sekolah makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Speed of Sekolah
legendary.text: The maw of Sekolah moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The ferocious spirit of Sekolah flashes through the water, tearing through the foes of the maw of Sekolah. Each creature of the maw's choosing within 60 feet of it must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.description:
Summoned from the shadowy depths of the ocean through ritual and tidal magic, the Maw of Sekolah appears in The Final Enemy as the avatar of the hungry sahuagin god. This huge, two-headed shark is fed a steady diet of sentient creatures, captured by the sahuagin and offered up as tribute. Sahuagin priestesses adorn the fins of the maw of Sekolah with gemmed bands and polished skulls.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 244

monster.name: Merfolk Salvager

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The salvager can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The salvager makes two attacks with its coral rapier.

action.name: Coral Rapier
action.text: Melee Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Inject Toxin (2/Day)
action.text: Melee Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

monster.description:
Veterans of scouring the wrecks and ruins found in the deepest waters, these skilled warriors help defend their kin with rapier-like weapons of living coral. The salvagers escort other merfolk on scavenging missions, using their keen senses to detect danger. They are found allying with the lizardfolk in Danger at Dunwater.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 244

monster.name: Merfolk Scout

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
trait.text: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: Merfolk can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 216

monster.name: Minotaur Living Crystal Statue
monster.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

trait.name: Immutable Form
trait.text: The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The statue makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one gore attack.

action.name: Greataxe
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Flying Shards
reaction.text: In response to a creature hitting the statue with a melee weapon attack, the statue deals 11 (2d10) piercing damage to the attacker.

monster.description:
Given life through powerful magic, a large, crudely carved crystal minotaur guards the tunnels in Isle of the Abbey.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 245

monster.name: Monstrous Peryton
monster.languages: understands Common and Elvish but can't speak

trait.name: Flyby
trait.text: The peryton doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
trait.text: The peryton has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the peryton fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The peryton makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its talons.

action.name: Gore
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Warp Shadow
action.text: The peryton chooses up to three creatures within 60 feet of it that it can see. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become cursed. While cursed, whenever the creature makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, it must roll a d4 and subtract that number from the roll. A cursed creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to this peryton's Warp Shadow for 24 hours.

legendary.text: The monstrosity can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The monstrosity regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
legendary.text: The peryton makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Talons Attack
legendary.text: The peryton makes one attack with its talons.

legendary.name: Dive Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The peryton moves up to its speed toward one target of its choosing. It then makes a gore attack that deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage on a hit.

monster.description:
The terror of the coast and the recent scourge of Firewatch Island in Tammeraut's Fate, this large peryton preys on ships and coastal communities alike. It has built numerous nests to mark its territory.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 245

monster.name: Mr. Dory
monster.languages: Abyssal, Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 60 ft.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Mr. Dory has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Water Dependency
trait.text: Mr. Dory takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the end of every hour he goes without exposure to water.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Mr. Dory makes three attacks with his rapier.

action.name: Rapier
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Eye of Corruption (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Mr. Dory glares at a creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and 27 (5d10) poison damage and then gains vulnerability to both necrotic and poison damage for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half damage and does not gain the vulnerabilities.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Mr. Dory's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Mr. Dory can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, invisibility (self only) • 2/Day each: fear, fireball, fly • 1/Day each: cloudkill, etherealness

monster.spells: detect magic, detect thoughts, invisibility, fear, fireball, fly, cloudkill, etherealness
monster.description:
One of the four councillors who rule the Styes, Mr. Dory hides his cursed nature in plain sight. His rare, liquid-sensitive "skin condition" is actually a form of the same aboleth affliction that creates skum, though Dory's condition is not as severe, and he has managed to retain his free will.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 246

monster.name: Oceanus

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: Oceanus can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Friend of the Sea
trait.text: Using gestures and sounds, Oceanus can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.

action.name: Trident
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Light Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

monster.description:
Before being captured, this sea elf had been tasked with investigating the Sea Ghost's movements in The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh. Oceanus is a smart and resourceful elf who is more than willing to join adventurers who have brave hearts and good intentions.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 246

monster.name: Othokent

trait.name: Hold Breath
trait.text: Othokent can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: Skewer
trait.text: Once per turn, when Othokent makes a melee attack with its trident and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage, and Othokent gains temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Othokent makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or trident or two melee attacks with its trident.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Trident
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monster.description: Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh p. 81

monster.name: Pirate Bosun

trait.name: Cargo Hauler
trait.text: The bosun has advantage on Strength checks.

trait.name: Sea Legs
trait.text: The bosun has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

action.name: Light Hammer
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hook
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

monster.description:
