monster.name: Atash
monster.resist: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 166

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
trait.text: Atash's weapon attacks are magical. When Atash hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Divine Awareness
trait.text: Atash knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Atash has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Atash's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only) • 3/Day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, resurrection • 1/Day each: commune, control weather

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Atash makes two greatsword attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Slaying Longbow
action.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.
If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.

action.name: Flying Sword
action.text: Atash releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If Atash can see the sword, Atash can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 feet and either make one attack against a target or return to Atash's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, Atash is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if Atash dies.

action.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
action.text: Atash touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Atash can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Atash regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Teleport
legendary.text: Atash magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Atash emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Atash targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

action.name: Bite

monster.name: Bakunawa
monster.speed: walk 20 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 60 ft.
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 147

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The bakunawa can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the bakunawa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The bakunawa makes one Bite attack and one Storm Slam attack.

action.name: Bite
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the bakunawa. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the bakunawa. At the start of each of the bakunawa's turns, each swallowed creature takes 10 (3d6) lightning damage. The bakunawa's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the bakunawa takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the bakunawa must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 15 feet of the bakunawa. If the bakunawa dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Storm Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet in a horizontal direction away from the bakunawa.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The Bakunawa can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Bakunawa regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Nimble Glide
legendary.text: The bakunawa flies or swims up to half its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Slam
legendary.text: The bakunawa makes one Storm Slam attack.

legendary.name: Lightning Strikes (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: The bakunawa arcs lightning at up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) lightning damage.

monster.name: Haint
monster.speed: walk 30 ft., fly 30 ft.(hover), canHover true ft.
monster.resist: acid, fire, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.languages: any languages it knew in life
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 185

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
trait.text: The haint can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The haint doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The haint makes two Sorrowful Touch attacks.

action.name: Sorrowful Touch
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) psychic damage.

action.name: Change Shape
action.text: The haint magically assumes the appearance of the Humanoid it was in life, while retaining its game statistics. The assumed appearance ends if the haint is reduced to 0 hit points or uses an action to end it.

action.name: Shared Sorrow (Bonus Action)
action.text: The haint targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself that is missing any hit points, sharing its own torment with this pained soul. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the haint's Shared Sorrow for the next 24 hours.

monster.name: Jade Soldier Statue
monster.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 194

trait.name: Immutable Form
trait.text: The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The statue has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.text: The statue's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The statue targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Both trees must be large or bigger.

trait.text:
Lungtian's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). Lungtian can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: druidcraft • 3/Day each: entangle, goodberry • 1/Day each: barkskin, pass without trace, shillelagh

action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+6 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

action.name: Fey Charm
action.text: Lungtian targets one humanoid or beast that she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see Lungtian, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. The charmed creature regards Lungtian as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Lungtian's control, it takes Lungtian's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time Lungtian or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Lungtian dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to Lungtian's Fey Charm for the next 24 hours. Lungtian can have no more than one humanoid and up to three beasts charmed at a time.

action.name: Plague Winds (Fiend Form Only; Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Serapio emits a chilling, disease-ridden wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 26 (4d12) cold damage and become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the creature can't regain hit points. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. If the creature is in direct sunlight when it makes this saving throw, it automatically succeeds on the save. If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a poison or disease, such as lesser restoration, while the creature isn't in direct sunlight, the effect does not end.

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Sholeh's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
action.text:
Sholeh uses one of the following breath weapons:
Fire Breath. Sholeh exhales fire in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Sleep Breath. Sholeh exhales sleep gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

action.name: Change Shape
action.text: Sholeh magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Sholeh's choice). In a new form, Sholeh retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Sholeh can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Sholeh regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
legendary.text: Sholeh makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
legendary.text: Sholeh makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Sholeh beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of Sholeh must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Sholeh can then fly up to half its flying speed.

monster.name: Soul Shaker
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 47

trait.name: Enthralled Lure (1/Day)
trait.text: The soul shaker can cast the geas spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

trait.name: Reconstruction
trait.text: When the soul shaker is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes into 7 (1d4 + 5) crawling claws. After 6 (1d12) days, if at least two of those crawling claws are alive, they teleport to the location of the soul shaker's death and merge together, whereupon the soul shaker reforms and regains all its hit points.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The soul shaker doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The soul shaker can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

action.name: Consume Vitality (Bonus Action)
action.text:
The soul shaker targets a creature it is grappling. If the target is not a Construct or an Undead, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the soul shaker regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

monster.name: Tlacatecolo
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 65

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The tlacatecolo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The tlacatecolo makes two Talon attacks.

action.name: Talon
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (3d8) poison damage.

action.name: Change Shape
action.text: The tlacatecolo magically transforms into a Medium owl, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the tlacatecolo is reduced to 0 hit points or if it uses its action to end it.

action.name: Plague Winds (Fiend Form Only; Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The tlacatecolo emits a chilling, disease-ridden wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 26 (4d12) cold damage and become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the creature can't regain hit points. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. If the creature is in direct sunlight when it makes this saving throw, it automatically succeeds on the save. If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a poison or disease, such as lesser restoration, while the creature isn't in direct sunlight, the effect does not end.

monster.name: Tlexolotl
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 119

trait.name: Fire Aura
trait.text:
At the start of each of the tlexolotl's turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in that aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite.
A creature that touches the tlexolotl or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Illumination
trait.text: The tlexolotl sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: The tlexolotl regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the tlexolotl takes cold damage or is immersed in water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the tlexolotl's next turn. The tlexolotl dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The tlexolotl makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the tlexolotl and knocked prone.

action.name: Pyroclasm (Recharge 5-6)
action.text:
Gouts of molten lava erupt from the tlexolotl's body. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the tlexolotl must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage.
On a successful saving throw, a creature takes half as much damage.

monster.name: Tonalli
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 110

trait.name: Divine Eminence
trait.text: As a bonus action, Tonalli can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Tonalli expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: Tonalli has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Tonalli is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Tonalli has the following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy • 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary • 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon • 3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians

action.name: Mace
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

monster.spells: light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy, cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary, lesser restoration, spiritual weapon, dispel magic, spirit guardians

monster.name: Tungsten Ward
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 38

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Tungsten is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). Tungsten has following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy • 1st level (3 slots): bless, cure wounds, sanctuary

action.name: Club
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

monster.spells: light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy, bless, cure wounds, sanctuary

monster.name: Uzoma Baten
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 94

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: Uzoma has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

action.name: Spear
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monster.name: Vi Aroon
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 24

action.name: Rapier
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Vi adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Vi must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Wei Feng Ying
monster.resist: damage from spells; nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing (from stoneskin)
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 188

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Wei Feng has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Wei Feng is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Wei Feng can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp • 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, mage armor*, magic missile • 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step • 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fly, lightning bolt • 4th level (3 slots): banishment, fire shield, stoneskin* • 5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, scrying, wall of force • 6th level (1 slots): globe of invulnerability • 7th level (1 slots): teleport • 8th level (1 slots): mind blank* • 9th level (1 slots): time stop
*Wei Feng casts these spells on itself before combat.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.spells: disguise self, invisibility, fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp, detect magic, identify, mage armor, magic missile, detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step, counterspell, fly, lightning bolt, banishment, fire shield, stoneskin, cone of cold, scrying, wall of force, globe of invulnerability, teleport, mind blank, time stop

monster.name: Whistler
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 221

trait.name: Blurred Form
trait.text: Attack rolls against the whistler are made with disadvantage unless the whistler is incapacitated.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The whistler doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The whistler makes three Psychic Swipe attacks.

action.name: Psychic Swipe
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage.

action.name: Otherworldly Melody (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The whistler telepathically whistles an otherworldly melody into the minds of up to two creatures it can see within range of its telepathy. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 33 (6d10) psychic damage and become frightened of the whistler for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Surreal Step (Bonus Action)
action.text: The whistler teleports up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monster.name: White Jade Emperor
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 197

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: White has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

action.name: Rapier
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: The emperor adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the emperor must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Wynling
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 33

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Cloak of the Mountain (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: The wynling magically turns invisible, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, for 1 minute or until it makes an attack roll.

reaction.name: Trickster's Flight
reaction.text: Immediately after a creature the wynling can see misses the wynling with an attack roll, the wynling can move up to 30 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

monster.name: Xocopol
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 112

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The giant makes two greathammer attacks.

action.name: Greathammer
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Yarana
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 212

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
trait.text: Yarana has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Yarana makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.name: Young-Gi
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 85

action.name: Rapier
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Young-Gi adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Young-Gi must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Zisatta
monster.description: Source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel p. 177

trait.name: Water Breathing
trait.text: Zisatta can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Spear
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monster.name: Fume Drake
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p. 41

trait.name: Death Burst
trait.text: When the fume drake dies, it explodes in a cloud of noxious fumes. Each creature within 5 feet of the fume drake must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 4 (1d8) poison damage.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The fume drake doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) fire damage.

action.name: Scalding Breath (Recharge 6)
action.text: The fume drake exhales a 15-foot cone of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Kobold Tinkerer
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p. 43

trait.name: Inquiring Mind (1/Day)
trait.text: The kobold can cast detect magic, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Alchemical Flame (Recharge 6)
action.text: The kobold unleashes fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Myla
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p.

trait.name: Inquiring Mind (1/Day)
trait.text: Myla can cast detect magic, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: Myla has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Myla has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Alchemical Flame (Recharge 6)
action.text: Myla unleashes fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Runara
monster.speed: walk 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p. 40

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: Runara can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Runara fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Runara can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
action.text: Each creature of Runara's choice that is within 120 feet of Runara and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Runara's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Runara uses one of the following breath weapons. Lightning Breath. Runara exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Repulsion Breath. Runara exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 60 feet away from Runara.

action.name: Change Shape
action.text: Runara magically transforms into a Humanoid or Beast that is Medium or Small, while retaining her game statistics (other than her size). This transformation ends if Runara is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

monster.name: Sinensa
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p. 45

trait.name: Distress Spores
trait.text: When Sinensa takes damage, all other myconids within 240 feet of it can sense its pain.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
trait.text: While in sunlight, Sinensa has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Sinensa dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The myconid makes one Fist attack and uses its Hallucination Spores.

action.name: Fist
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (3d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d4) poison damage.

action.name: Hallucination Spores
action.text: Sinensa ejects spores at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned target is incapacitated while it hallucinates. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Rapport Spores
action.text: A 30-foot radius of spores extends from Sinensa. These spores can go around corners and affect only creatures with an Intelligence of 2 or higher that aren't undead, constructs, or elementals. Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another while they are within 30 feet of each other. The effect lasts for 1 hour.

monster.name: Spore Servant Octopus
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p. 46

trait.name: Hold Breath
trait.text: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Water Breathing
trait.text: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Tentacles
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Tarak
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p. 47

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Tarak makes three Dagger attacks.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Cunning Action (bonus action)
action.text: Tarak takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monster.name: Varnoth
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p. 47

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Varnoth makes three Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

monster.name: Violet Fungus
monster.description: Source: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle p.

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: If the violet fungus is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the fungus move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the violet fungus isn't ordinary fungus.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The fungus makes 1d4 Rotting Touch attacks.

action.name: Rotting Touch
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

monster.name: Andir Valmakos
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 210

trait.name: Bonus Proficiencies
trait.text: Andir is proficient with simple weapons and light armor.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Andir's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
• At will: light, ray of frost • 1st level (2 slots): thunderwave

action.name: Arcane Burst
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.

action.name: Quarterstaff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

monster.spells: light, ray of frost, thunderwave

monster.name: Anhkolox
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 192

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The anhkolox doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The anhkolox makes two Claw attacks and one Entrapping Rend attack.

action.name: Claw
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet in a horizontal direction of the anhkolox's choice.

action.name: Entrapping Rend
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (5d6 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be trapped in the anhkolox's rib cage and grappled (escape DC 18).
Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the anhkolox can't use Entrapping Rend on another target.

monster.name: Aurak Draconian
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 196

trait.name: Aura of Command
trait.text: The draconian radiates a commanding presence in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. A draconian in the aura that can see or hear the aurak can't be charmed and has advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the frightened condition on itself.

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its magical essence lashes out as a ball of lightning at the closest creature within 30 feet of it before arcing out to up to two other creatures within 15 feet of the first. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
The draconian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
• At will: invisibility, mage hand • 1/Day: dominate person • 2/Day each: dimension door, disguise self, sending

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes three Rend or Energy Ray attacks.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Energy Ray
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

action.name: Noxious Breath (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The draconian exhales a 15-foot cone of noxious gas. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and gains 1 level of exhaustion. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, doesn't gain exhaustion, and is immune to all draconians' Noxious Breath for 24 hours.

monster.spells: invisibility, mage hand, dominate person, dimension door, disguise self, sending

monster.name: Ayik Ur
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 210

trait.name: Attacker
trait.text: Ayik gains a +2 bonus to all attack rolls (included below).

trait.name: Bonus Proficiencies
trait.text: Ayik is proficient with simple and martial weapons, shields, and all armor.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

monster.name: Baaz Draconian
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 197

trait.name: Controlled Fall
trait.text: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage.

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its body turns to stone and releases a petrifying gas. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends; otherwise the creature is petrified for 1 minute. After 1 minute, the body of the draconian crumbles to dust.

trait.name: Draconic Devotion
trait.text: While the draconian can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to it, the draconian has advantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monster.name: Bozak Draconian
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 198

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its scales and flesh immediately shrivel away, and then its bones explode. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage.

trait.name: Glide
trait.text: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
The draconian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
• 1/Day each: enlarge/reduce, invisibility, stinking cloud, web

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Trident melee attacks or two Lightning Discharge attacks.

action.name: Trident
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Lightning Discharge
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) lightning damage.

monster.spells: enlarge/reduce, invisibility, stinking cloud, web

monster.name: Caradoc
monster.speed: walk 0 ft., fly 40 ft.(hover), canHover true ft.
monster.resist: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 193

trait.name: Bound Haunting
trait.text: Caradoc's spirit is bound to Dargaard Keep. At the start of his turn, if he's outside the keep's walls and not possessing a creature using his Possession action, he must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or vanish and reappear in an unoccupied space within the keep.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
trait.text: Caradoc can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. He takes 5 (1d10) force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
trait.text: If Caradoc dies, he reforms within Dargaard Keep in 2d6 days.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: Caradoc doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Caradoc makes two Withering Touch attacks.

action.name: Withering Touch
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

action.name: Possession (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: One Humanoid that Caradoc can see within 5 feet of himself must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by him; he then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Caradoc now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Caradoc can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn Undead, and he retains his alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, immunity to being charmed and frightened, and his Divisive Whispers bonus action. He otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Caradoc ends it as a bonus action, or he is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Caradoc reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Caradoc's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

action.name: Divisive Whispers (bonus action)
action.text: Caradoc magically whispers to one creature within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, or the target must immediately use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of Caradoc's choice (wasting its reaction if there are no other creatures within reach).

monster.name: Dracophage Subject
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 118

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it dissolves into acid that splashes on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature.

trait.name: Glide
trait.text: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

action.name: Claw
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be infected with a disease—a minuscule slaad egg. A Humanoid host can carry only one slaad egg at a time. Over three months, the egg moves to the chest cavity, gestates, and forms a slaad tadpole. In the 24-hour period before the tadpole is born, the host feels unwell; its speed is halved; and it has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. At birth, the tadpole chews its way through vital organs and out of the host's chest in 1 round, killing the host in the process. If the disease is cured before the tadpole's emergence, the tadpole disintegrates.

monster.name: Dragon Army Dragonnel
monster.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 201

trait.name: Flyby
trait.text: The dragonnel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragonnel makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

monster.name: Dragon Army Officer
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 200

trait.name: Draconic Devotion
trait.text: While the officer can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to it, the officer has advantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The officer makes two Vicious Lance attacks and uses Assault Orders if it's available.

action.name: Vicious Lance
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Assault Orders (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The officer shouts orders and targets up to two other creatures within 60 feet of itself. If a target has the Draconic Devotion trait and can hear the officer, the target can use its reaction to make one melee attack.

monster.name: Dragon Army Soldier
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 200

trait.name: Draconic Devotion
trait.text: While the soldier can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to it, the soldier has advantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The soldier makes two Longsword or Javelin attacks.

action.name: Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

action.name: Javelin
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

monster.name: Fewmaster Gholcag
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 74

action.name: Greatclub
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

monster.name: Greater Death Dragon
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 195

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the dragon can't bite a different target.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Cataclysmic Breath (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The dragon exhales a wave of ghostly purple flames in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature dies if the breath reduces it to 0 hit points. Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by the breath's damage, as well as every corpse of such a creature within the cone, becomes a zombie (see the Monster Manual) under the dragon's control. The zombie acts on the dragon's initiative but immediately after the dragon's turn. Absent any other command, the zombie tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The Greater Death Dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Greater Death Dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Claw
legendary.text: The dragon makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text:
The dragon moves up to half its flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks, carrying with it any creatures it is grappling. During this move, if it enters the space of a Medium or smaller creature, that creature takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

monster.name: Hrigg Roundrook
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 212

trait.name: Bonus Proficiencies
trait.text: Hrigg is proficient with simple and martial weapons and light and medium armor.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: Hrigg has advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the poisoned condition on himself.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Hrigg's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:
• At will: guidance, sacred flame • 1st level (2 slots): cure wounds

action.name: Maul
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monster.spells: guidance, sacred flame, cure wounds

monster.name: Incomplete Dragon Skeleton
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 138

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

monster.name: Iriad
monster.skill: nature +2, survival +3, stealth +5, investigation +2, athletics +2, acrobatics +5, perception +5
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 212

trait.name: Bonus Proficiencies
trait.text: Iriad is proficient with simple weapons, light armor, cartographer's tools, and woodcarver's tools.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Iriad has advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself, and magic can't put her to sleep.

action.name: Poison Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Helpful (bonus action)
action.text: Iriad takes the Help action.

monster.name: Istarian Drone
monster.languages: understands the languages spoken by its creator but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 202

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The drone can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The drone doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The drone makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage.
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The drone has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Crystalline Spit (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The drone spits crackling gel in a line 5 feet wide and 20 feet long. Each creature in the line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) lightning damage and is restrained by the gel, which hardens into crystal. The creature is restrained until the crystal is destroyed. The crystal has AC 15, 15 hit points, immunity to poison and psychic damage, and vulnerability to thunder damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

monster.name: Kalaman Soldier
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 202

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The soldier makes two Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

reaction.name: Hold the Line
reaction.text: If an ally within 5 feet of the soldier must make a saving throw, the soldier encourages the ally, granting advantage on the roll.

monster.name: Kansaldi Fire-Eyes
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 203

trait.name: Special Equipment
trait.text: Kansaldi has a glowing ruby embedded in her left eye socket. The gem functions as her eye and grants her truesight (included above). The gem can't be removed while Kansaldi is alive. When she dies, a creature can remove the gem as an action. The gem then functions as a gem of seeing.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Kansaldi casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
• At will: light, spare the dying, thaumaturgy • 1/Day each: blade barrier, dispel magic, flame strike, lesser restoration, revivify

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Kansaldi makes two Pike attacks and uses Flame Burst.

action.name: Pike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) radiant damage.

action.name: Flame Burst
action.text: Kansaldi hurls magical flames at a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 11 (2d10) fire damage and catches fire; until a creature takes an action to put out the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't catch fire.

action.name: Dragon Queen's Favor (bonus action)
action.text: Kansaldi or one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself magically regains 17 (2d12 + 4) hit points.

monster.spells: light, spare the dying, thaumaturgy, blade barrier, dispel magic, flame strike, lesser restoration, revivify

monster.name: Kapak Draconian
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 198

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it dissolves into acid that splashes on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature.

trait.name: Glide
trait.text: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Dagger attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of the target's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

monster.name: Kender Skirmisher
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 204

action.name: Hoopak
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage if the kender used the hoopak's sling to make a ranged attack.

action.name: Taunt
action.text: The kender launches a barrage of insults at a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. If the target can hear the kender, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Elusive (bonus action)
action.text: The kender takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monster.name: Leedara
monster.resist: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.languages: Any languages she knew in life
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 58

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
trait.text: Leedara can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when she is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
trait.text: Leedara can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

action.name: Withering Touch
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
action.text: Leedara enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. She is visible on the Material Plane while she is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet she can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
action.text: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Leedara that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Leedara's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

action.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
action.text: One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Leedara; Leedara then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Leedara now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Leedara can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and she retains her alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. She otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Leedara ends it as a bonus action, or Leedara is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Leedara reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Leedara's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

action.name: Change Shape
action.text: Leedara magically assumes the appearance she had in life, and her creature type changes to Humanoid, while retaining her other game statistics. This transformation ends if Leedara is reduced to 0 hit points or uses an action to end it.

monster.name: Lesser Death Dragon
monster.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 195

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage.
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The dragon has two claws, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Cataclysmic Breath (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The dragon exhales a wave of ghostly purple flames in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature dies if the breath reduces it to 0 hit points. Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by the breath's damage, as well as every corpse of such a creatures within the cone, becomes a zombie (see the Monster Manual) under the dragon's control. The zombie acts on the dragon's initiative but immediately after the dragon's turn. Absent any other command, the zombie tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

monster.name: Levna Drakehorn
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 212

trait.name: Bonus Proficiencies
trait.text: Levna is proficient with simple and martial weapons, shields, and all armor.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: Levna has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of her allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Greatsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Protection
reaction.text: When a creature Levna can see within 5 feet of her is targeted by an attack, she can impose disadvantage on the attack roll if she can see the attacker and she is wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Lohezet
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 205

trait.name: Toxic Mastery
trait.text: Lohezet ignores a creature's resistance to poison damage.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Lohezet casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
• At will: detect magic, light, prestidigitation • 2/Day each: dimension door, mage armor • 1/Day each: arcane eye, dominate person, wall of force

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Lohezet makes three Withering Blast attacks and uses Miasma if it's available. He can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Withering Blast
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) necrotic damage.

action.name: Miasma (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Lohezet magically conjures a billowing cloud of purple fog in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of himself. The area within the sphere is heavily obscured, and when a creature starts its turn in the sphere or enters the sphere for the first time on a turn, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 39 (6d12) poison damage and is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. The cloud lasts for 1 minute, until Lohezet ends it early (no action required), or until Lohezet uses this action again. A strong wind disperses the cloud.

reaction.name: Noxious Rebuke (3/Day)
reaction.text: When a creature within 60 feet of Lohezet damages him, Lohezet magically retaliates with a spray of foul, purple mist. The creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (2d10 + 5) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.spells: detect magic, light, prestidigitation, dimension door, mage armor, arcane eye, dominate person, wall of force

monster.name: Lord Soth
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 206

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Soth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Soth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Marshal Undead
trait.text: Unless Soth is incapacitated, he and Undead creatures of his choice within 60 feet of him are immune to features that turn Undead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: Soth doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Soth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
• At will: command (cast at 3rd level) • 1/Day: banishment (cast at 6th level) • 2/Day each: dispel magic, hold person (cast at 3rd level)

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Soth makes three Forsaken Brand attacks.

action.name: Forsaken Brand
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Soth's next turn.

action.name: Cataclysmic Fire (1/Day)
action.text: Soth hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point he can see within 120 feet of himself. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by this damage, as well as every corpse of such a creature within the sphere, becomes a skeleton (see the Monster Manual) under Soth's control. The skeleton acts on Soth's initiative but immediately after his turn. Absent any other command, the skeleton tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

action.name: Word of Death (1/Day)
action.text: Soth points at a creature he can see within 60 feet of himself and magically commands it to die. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 100 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target dies.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Lord Soth can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Lord Soth regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Implacable Maneuver
legendary.text: Soth moves up to his speed or commands a mount he is riding to move up to its speed. The movement from this action doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. If he or his mount moves within 5 feet of a creature during this movement, he can force the creature to make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. The creature is knocked prone unless it succeeds on the saving throw.

legendary.name: Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Soth makes one Forsaken Brand attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Soth uses Spellcasting.

monster.spells: command, banishment, dispel magic, hold person

monster.name: Red Ruin
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 208

trait.name: Draconic Devotion
trait.text: While Red Ruin can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to her, she has advantage on attack rolls.

trait.name: Mounted Combat Master
trait.text: When Red Ruin is mounted and a creature targets her mount with an attack, Red Ruin can cause the attack to target her instead.

trait.name: Mounted Evasion
trait.text: When Red Ruin or her mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage from an effect, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Red Ruin makes three Ember Lance attacks.

action.name: Ember Lance
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Explosive Hand Crossbow (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Red Ruin fires an explosive crossbow bolt at a point she can see within 120 feet of herself. When the bolt reaches that point, or if it hits an object early, it detonates in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Sea Elf Scout
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 114

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
trait.text: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: The scout has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Child of the Sea
trait.text: The scout can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.name: Sivak Draconian
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 199

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points by a creature that is Large or smaller, the draconian crumbles into dust that then forms a spectral, shrieking image of the creature that killed it. The image lasts for 1 minute. Each creature hostile to the draconian within 10 feet of the image must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the spectral image for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Serrated Sword attacks and one Tail attack.

action.name: Serrated Sword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Shape Theft
reaction.text: After the draconian kills a Medium or smaller Humanoid, the draconian magically cloaks itself in an illusion to look and feel like that creature while retaining the draconian's game statistics (other than its size). This transformation lasts until the draconian dies or uses a bonus action to end it.

monster.name: Skeletal Knight
monster.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 208

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
trait.text: If damage reduces the skeletal knight to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is bludgeoning or from a critical hit. On a success, the skeletal knight drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The skeletal knight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The skeletal knight makes three Enervating Blade or Throwing Axe attacks in any combination.

action.name: Enervating Blade
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the skeletal knight's next turn.

action.name: Throwing Axe
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

monster.name: Tem Temble
monster.skill: insight +4, stealth +4, sleight of hand +4, medicine +4, perception +4
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 212

trait.name: Bonus Proficiencies
trait.text: Tem is proficient with simple weapons and light armor.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Tem's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:
• At will: druidcraft, poison spray • 1st level (2 slots): healing word

action.name: Hoopak
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, or 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if Tem used the hoopak's sling to make a ranged attack.

action.name: Taunt
action.text: Tem launches an infuriating barrage of insults at a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can hear Tem, it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Elusive (bonus action)
action.text: Tem takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monster.spells: druidcraft, poison spray, healing word

monster.name: Virruza
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 119

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When Virruza is reduced to 0 hit points, he turns into a puddle of acid and splashes acid on those around him. Each creature within 5 feet of him must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Virruza has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Virruza regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Virruza's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). Virruza can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, mage hand • 1/Day: fireball • 2/Day each: fear, invisibility (self only)

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Virruza makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws or staff. Alternatively, he uses his Hurl Flame twice.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Staff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
action.text:
Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage.
The fire ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.

monster.spells: detect magic, detect thoughts, mage hand, fireball, fear, invisibility

monster.name: Wasteland Dragonnel
monster.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 201

trait.name: Flyby
trait.text: The dragonnel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragonnel makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Spit
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) acid damage.

monster.name: Wersten Kern
monster.description: Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen p. 209

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
trait.text: If damage reduces Wersten to 0 hit points, she must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is bludgeoning or from a critical hit. On a success, Wersten drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: Wersten doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Wersten casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
• 1/Day each: dispel magic, wall of stone

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Wersten makes three Banner Pike attacks and uses Terrifying Litany if it's available.

action.name: Banner Pike
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. The curse lasts until it is lifted by remove curse or similar magic. Black, thorny rose stems sprout from the creature's body while it is cursed, imposing disadvantage on the creature's ability checks and attack rolls and halving its speed. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw against the curse is immune to it for 24 hours.

action.name: Terrifying Litany (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Wersten recites names of souls slain by Soth and his company, channeling their mortal terror. Each creature that isn't an Undead within 30 feet of her must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is frightened of Wersten for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened.
