action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16) and must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Extract Brain
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Humanoid grappled by the mind flayer. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the mind flayer kills it by extracting and devouring its brain.

action.name: Mind Whip (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The mind flayer lashes out with psychic energy, targeting up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 23 (4d8 + 5) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The mind flayer casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
• At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, levitate • 1/Day each: dominate monster, plane shift (self only), true seeing

monster.spells: detect magic, detect thoughts, levitate, dominate monster, plane shift, true seeing

monster.name: Mormesk the Wraith
monster.resist: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.languages: the languages it knew in life
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
trait.text: Mormesk can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Mormesk has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Life Drain
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Create Specter
action.text: Mormesk targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under Mormesk's control. Mormesk can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

monster.name: Nellik
monster.resist: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 193

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Nellik's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. Nellik can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, invisibility (self only), mirror image

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Nellik has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
trait.text: Nellik's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Nellik makes two melee attacks, or it makes one melee attack and teleports before or after the attack.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns due to a fiendish wound. Each time Nellik hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 5 (2d4). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

action.name: Greataxe
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage; if the target is an Aberration, it takes an additional 6 (1d12) slashing damage, and if it is grappling a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or its grapple ends.

action.name: Teleport
action.text: Nellik magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monster.spells: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, invisibility, mirror image

monster.name: Nezznar the Spider
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 74

trait.name: Special Equipment
trait.text: Nezznar has a fully charged spider staff (see appendix B).

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Nezznar has advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself, and magic can't put him to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: Nezznar has disadvantage on attack rolls while he or his target is in sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Nezznar makes two Poison Blast attacks.

action.name: Poison Blast
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d8) poison damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Nezznar casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13 unless otherwise noted):
• At will: dancing lights, mage hand, spider climb (from spider staff), web (from spider staff; save DC 15) • 1/Day each: darkness, faerie fire, invisibility, mage armor, magic missile, suggestion

monster.spells: dancing lights, mage hand, spider climb, web, darkness, faerie fire, invisibility, mage armor, magic missile, suggestion

monster.name: Nundro Rockseeker
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: Nundro has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

action.name: Club
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Nythalyn Henlifel
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Nythalyn has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Nythalyn to sleep.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Nythalyn's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: dancing lights • 1/Day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Nythalyn has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Nythalyn makes two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Nythalyn adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Nythalyn must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.spells: dancing lights, darkness, faerie fire, levitate

monster.name: Oculorb
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 214

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The oculorb has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Watchful Eyes
trait.text: The oculorb has advantage on initiative rolls and can't be surprised.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The oculorb makes two Dreadful Contact attacks or four Eye Beam attacks.

action.name: Dreadful Contact
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage, or 25 (6d6 + 4) psychic damage if the target has the frightened condition.

action.name: Eye Beam
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage.

action.name: Antipathic Flood (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The oculorb releases a wave of negative emotions, choosing one of the following options:

action.name: Weeping Eyes
action.text: The oculorb weeps, releasing a wave of crushing despair. Each creature within 30 feet of the oculorb must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature's speed is reduced to 0 feet until the end of the oculorb's next turn, and if the creature was concentration, its concentration is broken.

action.name: Withering Glare
action.text: The oculorb's eyes unleash furious scarlet energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.

reaction.name: Obsessive Rebuke
reaction.text: When the oculorb is damaged by a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself, it forces the creature to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. The creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Ontharyx
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Ontharyx has disadvantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Ontharyx makes two Unarmed Strike or Nightmare Blast attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Nightmare Blast
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of Ontharyx's next turn.

reaction.name: Defensive Flight
reaction.text: Immediately after taking damage, Ontharyx flies up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

monster.name: Oshundo the Alhoon
monster.languages: Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 120 ft., Undercommon
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 153

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Oshundo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Oshundo makes two Chilling Grasp or Arcane Bolt attacks.

action.name: Chilling Grasp
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) cold damage, and Oshundo regains 14 hit points if the target is a creature.

action.name: Arcane Bolt
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (8d6) force damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Oshundo casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
• At will: dancing lights, detect magic, detect thoughts, disguise self, mage hand, prestidigitation • 1/Day each: dominate monster, globe of invulnerability, invisibility, modify memory, plane shift (self only), wall of force

action.name: Thundering Blast (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Oshundo emits a wave of domineering energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) thunder damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Negate Spell (3/Day)
reaction.text: Oshundo targets one creature it can perceive within 60 feet of itself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, the spell fails, but any spell slots or charges aren't wasted.

monster.spells: dancing lights, detect magic, detect thoughts, disguise self, mage hand, prestidigitation, dominate monster, globe of invulnerability, invisibility, modify memory, plane shift, wall of force

monster.name: Otyugh Mutate
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 213

trait.name: Virulent Breath
trait.text: Noxious gas from the mutate's digestion of previous meals spews from its mouth. At the start of the mutate's turn, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The mutate makes two Bite or Tentacle attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Chitin Slam.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. On a successful save, the target is no longer poisoned. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until it no longer has the poisoned condition.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 15) and the restrained condition until this grapple ends. The mutate has two tentacles that can grapple one target each.

action.name: Chitin Slam
action.text: The mutate targets one creature it is grappling, slamming the creature against its chitinous plating. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage and have the stunned condition until the end of the mutate's next turn.

monster.name: Psionic Ashenwight
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious
monster.languages: telepathy 120 ft., understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 204

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The ashenwight makes two Necrotic Shard attacks. It also uses Psionic Crown if available.

action.name: Necrotic Shard
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Psionic Crown (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The ashenwight wreathes the head of a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself with a crown of jagged, spectral crystals. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the target's thoughts are sluggish; it can't take reactions, its speed is halved, and it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The ashenwight casts one of the following spells, requiring no spellcasting components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
• At will: mage hand (the hand is invisible) • 1/Day: calm emotions

monster.spells: mage hand, calm emotions

monster.name: Psionic Shambling Mound
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 108

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
trait.text: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Engulf
action.text: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The shambling mound casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 8):
• At will: minor illusion • 1/Day: charm person (already cast)

monster.spells: minor illusion, charm person

monster.name: Qunbraxel
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 135

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Qunbraxel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Qunbraxel makes two Eldritch Bolt attacks, or one Eldritch Bolt attack and one Tentacle attack.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16) and must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Eldritch Bolt
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.

action.name: Extract Brain
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Humanoid with the stunned condition who is grappled by Qunbraxel. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Qunbraxel kills it by extracting and devouring its brain.

action.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Qunbraxel magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 26 (5d8 + 4) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
Qunbraxel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
• At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, levitate, mage armor (self only), mage hand (the hand is invisible), prestidigitation • 2/Day each: confusion, sending, telekinesis • 1/Day each: dominate monster, plane shift (self only)

monster.spells: detect magic, detect thoughts, levitate, mage armor, mage hand, prestidigitation, confusion, sending, telekinesis, dominate monster, plane shift

monster.name: Redbrand Ruffian
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 216

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.name: Refraction of Ilvaash
monster.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.languages: Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 100 miles, Undercommon
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 197

trait.name: Creature Sense
trait.text: The refraction is aware of creatures within 100 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each one's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
trait.text: The refraction can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
trait.text: If the refraction fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The refraction has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The refraction makes two Dissonant Claw attacks.

action.name: Dissonant Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) psychic damage. If the target is a creature concentration on a spell, its concentration is broken.

action.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Creatures of the refraction's choice within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 33 (5d10 + 6) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The refraction casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
• At will: detect magic, detect thoughts • 3/Day each: dispel magic, modify memory • 1/Day each: feeblemind, plane shift (self only)

action.name: Teleport
action.text: The refraction teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied place that it can see.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The Refraction of Ilvaash can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Refraction of Ilvaash regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Mindbreaker
legendary.text: The refraction targets a creature within 120 feet of itself and disrupts its mental processes, causing the target to have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of the target's next turn.

legendary.name: Projected Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The refraction makes one Dissonant Claw attack.

monster.spells: detect magic, detect thoughts, dispel magic, modify memory, feeblemind, plane shift

monster.name: Rivibiddel
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
trait.text: Rivibiddel has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Rivibiddel's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: nondetection (self only) • 1/Day each: blindness/deafness, blur, disguise self

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
trait.text: Rivibiddel has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: War Pick
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Poisoned Dart
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

monster.spells: nondetection, blindness/deafness, blur, disguise self

monster.name: Ruxithid the Chosen
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 99

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
trait.text: When Ruxithid fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mental Fortitude
trait.text: Ruxithid has advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Ruxithid makes two Psi-Charged Scimitar attacks.

action.name: Psi-Charged Scimitar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Brain Tendrils (Recharge 5-6) (bonus action)
action.text: Ruxithid unleashes a flurry of crystalline psychic tendrils from his brain, targeting one creature that he can see within 30 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) psychic damage and have the stunned condition until the start of Ruxithid's next turn.

action.name: Combat Command (bonus action)
action.text: Ruxithid commands one allied creature he can see within 60 feet of himself to strike. The creature can immediately use its reaction to make one melee weapon attack against a target within its reach.

monster.name: Shalfi Lewin
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Aberrant Form
trait.text: Shalfi exudes the chaos of the Far Realm. Any non-Aberration creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of Shalfi must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

trait.name: Weirdly Pliable
trait.text: Shalfi, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, is unnaturally flexible. Shalfi can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Shalfi makes one Psychic Rend attack and two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Psychic Rend
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of Shalfi's next turn.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
Shalfi casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
• At will: detect thoughts, minor illusion • 1/Day each: arcane gate, hunger of Hadar

action.name: Void Warp (Recharge 5-6) (bonus action)
action.text: Shalfi teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself, leaving a churning void in the space it left. Immediately after it teleports, each creature within 30 feet of the void other than Shalfi must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) force damage and is pulled to the unoccupied space closest to the void. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. The void then disappears.

monster.spells: detect thoughts, minor illusion, arcane gate, hunger of hadar

monster.name: Sildar Hallwinter
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p. 22

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Sildar makes two Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: When an attacker Sildar can see would hit him with a melee attack, he can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to his AC against the triggering attack, provided he's wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Varakkta
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
trait.text:
Varakkta's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• At will: mage hand (the hand is invisible) • 3/Day each: jump, misty step, nondetection (self only), tongues • 1/Day each: plane shift, telekinesis

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Varakkta makes two silver greatsword attacks.

action.name: Silver Greatsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. This is a magic weapon attack. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body (as with the astral projection spell), Varakkta can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body, instead of dealing damage.

monster.spells: mage hand, jump, misty step, nondetection, tongues, plane shift, telekinesis

monster.name: Voalsh
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Voalsh fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Voalsh has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Voalsh makes two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 17) and must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Extract Brain
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by Voalsh. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Voalsh kills it by extracting and devouring its brain.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
Voalsh casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
• At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, mage hand (the hand is invisible) • 1/Day: plane shift (self only) • 3/Day each: clairvoyance (as an action), dispel magic

action.name: Unleash Void (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Voalsh opens a rift into the Far Realm, centered on a point Voalsh can see within 60 feet of itself, and a tentacle lashes across creatures near the rift. Each creature other than mind flayers within 30 feet of the rift must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw, after which the tentacle disappears and the rift closes. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) cold damage from the rift plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage from the tentacle and has the stunned condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Warp Reality
reaction.text: When hit by an attack roll, Voalsh gains a +4 bonus to its AC against that attack roll, potentially causing it to miss. Then Voalsh, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monster.spells: detect magic, detect thoughts, mage hand, plane shift, clairvoyance, dispel magic

monster.name: Yanthdel Henlifel
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Yanthdel has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Yanthdel to sleep.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Yanthdel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: dancing lights • 1/Day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Yanthdel has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Yanthdel makes two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Yanthdel adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Yanthdel must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.spells: dancing lights, darkness, faerie fire, levitate

monster.name: Zeond
monster.resist: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk p.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text: Zeond can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (speed 10 feet fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., swim 40 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Zeond has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Claw (Bite in Beast Form)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Scare (1/Day)
action.text: One creature of Zeond's choice within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if Zeond is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Invisibility
action.text: Zeond magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Scare, or until its concentration ends (as if concentration on a spell). Any equipment Zeond wears or carries is invisible with it.

monster.name: Black Rose Bearer
monster.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 208

trait.name: Berserk
trait.text: Whenever the bearer takes damage or makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, the bearer goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the bearer has advantage on melee attack rolls, it can Dash as a bonus action, and it must attack the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the bearer attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the bearer goes berserk, it remains berserk until it is destroyed or its creator gives it a pristine black rose.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
trait.text: If damage reduces the bearer to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a successful save, the bearer drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The bearer makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

monster.name: Blade Lieutenant
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 209

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: The lieutenant has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lieutenant's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The lieutenant makes three Longsword or Javelin Launcher attacks.

action.name: Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Javelin Launcher
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target has the prone condition.

action.name: Command Ally (bonus action)
action.text: The lieutenant targets one ally it can see within 30 feet of itself. If the target can see or hear the lieutenant, the target can make one melee attack using its reaction, if available, and has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Rally the Troops (1/Day) (bonus action)
action.text: The lieutenant ends the charmed and frightened conditions on itself and each creature of its choice that it can see within 30 feet of itself.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: The lieutenant adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the lieutenant must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Blade Scout
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 209

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: The scout has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the scout's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The scout makes three Armblade or Bolt Launcher attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Snare Trap.

action.name: Armblade
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Bolt Launcher
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Snare Trap (1/Day)
action.text: The scout deploys a Tiny mechanical trap on a solid surface within 5 feet of itself. The trap is hidden, requiring a successful DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to find. The trap lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an enemy enters a space within 10 feet of the trap or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and have the prone condition. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.

action.name: Dash (bonus action)
action.text: The scout moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

monster.name: Blazebear
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 210

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The blazebear has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mist Sight
trait.text: The blazebear can see normally through heavily obscured areas created by mist or fog, including areas created by spells such as Fog Cloud.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The blazebear makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with Stunning Gaze if available.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

action.name: Stunning Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The blazebear targets two creatures it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of the blazebear's next turn.

reaction.name: Antimagic Swipe
reaction.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature casting a spell of 3rd level or lower. Hit: 22 (4d10) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or the spell fails and has no effect.

monster.name: Bone Roc
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 211

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The bone roc makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

action.name: Beak
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

monster.name: Borthak
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 212

trait.name: Glacial Aura
trait.text: At the end of the borthak's turn, slippery ice covers surfaces within 10 feet of the borthak. This ice is difficult terrain. When a creature other than the borthak enters the ice's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition. The ice disappears at the start of the borthak's next turn.

trait.name: Webbed Feet
trait.text: The borthak can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The borthak makes one Bite attack or uses Noxious Regurgitation if available, and it makes two Stomp attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Stomp
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Noxious Regurgitation (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The borthak spews acid at a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (7d6) acid damage and has the poisoned condition until the start of the borthak's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

reaction.name: Reactive Tail
reaction.text: When a creature within 10 feet of the borthak hits the borthak with an attack roll, the borthak swings its tail in retaliation. The triggering creature and any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The Borthak can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Borthak regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Move
legendary.text: The borthak moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The borthak makes one Bite attack.

monster.name: Citadel Spider
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 214

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The spider makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Web Bomb.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Web Bomb
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, range 300 ft./600 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target and all creatures within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage and have the restrained condition until the start of the spider's next turn.

reaction.name: Absorb Blow
reaction.text: In response to being hit with an attack roll, the spider's carapace absorbs some of the blow, reducing the damage it takes by 11 (2d10).

monster.name: Deadbark Dryad
monster.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 216

trait.name: Bramble Walk
trait.text: Difficult terrain composed of vegetation, such as foliage or thorns, doesn't cost the dryad extra movement.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
trait.text: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dryad makes two Poisonous Thorn attacks and one Sapping Vine attack.

action.name: Poisonous Thorn
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of the dryad's next turn.

action.name: Sapping Vine
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the dryad can't use the same vine on another target. A creature restrained in this way takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage at the start of its turn.
The dryad has six vines. Each vine can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a vine deals no damage to the dryad, but any creature grappled by that vine no longer has the grappled condition. All vines immediately wither and disappear when the dryad is reduced to 0 hit points.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
• At will: Druidcraft • 1/Day: Dispel Magic • 2/Day each: Pass without Trace, Spike Growth

monster.spells: druidcraft, dispel magic, pass without trace, spike growth

monster.name: Deathwolf
monster.immune: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 217

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
trait.text: If the deathwolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Moon's Grace
trait.text: When the deathwolf falls, it descends at a rate of 60 feet per round and takes no falling damage.

trait.name: Multiple Reactions
trait.text: The deathwolf can take up to two reactions per round but only one per turn.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The deathwolf makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Phantom Deathwolf if available.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on saving throws against the frightened condition. This curse lasts until removed by the Remove Curse spell or other magic.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Phantom Deathwolf (Recharge 5-6)
action.text:
The deathwolf creates a terrifying phantom of itself in the mind of a creature the deathwolf can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute.
While the target is frightened, the phantom deals 21 (6d6) psychic damage to the target at the start of each of the target's turns. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Imposing Slash
reaction.text: When a creature within 5 feet of the deathwolf makes an attack roll against it, the deathwolf forces the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on that roll. After the attack hits or misses, the deathwolf makes one Claw attack against the creature.

reaction.name: Phase Step
reaction.text: Immediately after taking damage, the deathwolf teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is in dim light or darkness.

monster.name: Degloth
monster.resist: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 218

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The degloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The degloth makes two Razor Fist attacks.

action.name: Razor Fist
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the degloth can't use this fist to grapple another target. The degloth has two fists.

action.name: Crush (bonus action)
action.text: The degloth targets one creature currently grappled by it. The target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: False Lich
monster.immune: necrotic, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned
monster.languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Giant, Infernal, Primordial, Undercommon
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 220

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the false lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The false lich has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The false lich makes two Death Rend attacks and uses Bloodcurdling Lament if available.

action.name: Death Rend
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

action.name: Bloodcurdling Lament (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The false lich emits a hideous shriek charged with malignant energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the false lich must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature also has the unconscious condition. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The false lich casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):
• At will: Detect Magic, Fly, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation • 3/Day each: Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only) • 1/Day each: Globe of Invulnerability, Hold Monster

action.name: Soul Siphon (bonus action)
action.text:
The false lich targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw; if the target has the unconscious condition, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. The target takes 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The false lich then regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of force damage taken.
If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target immediately dies, its body disappears, and its soul is trapped inside one of the soul gems within the false lich's skull. After 24 hours, the gem transfers the soul to the false lich's creator.
When the false lich is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and disintegrates, leaving behind the gems. Crushing a gem releases any souls trapped within, at which point the soul's body re-forms in an unoccupied space nearest to the gem and in the same state as it was when its soul was trapped.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The False Lich can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The False Lich regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Spiteful Teleport
legendary.text: The false lich, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of itself. It then makes one Death Rend attack if possible.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The false lich uses Spellcasting.

monster.spells: detect magic, fly, mage hand, prestidigitation, dispel magic, invisibility, globe of invulnerability, hold monster

monster.name: Granite Juggernaut
monster.immune: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 221

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The juggernaut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
trait.text: The juggernaut deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

action.name: Devastating Roll (bonus action)
action.text: The juggernaut moves up to its speed. During this movement, the juggernaut can move through the spaces of creatures with the prone condition. When the juggernaut enters the space of a prone creature for the first time during this movement, the creature must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Hazvongel
monster.resist: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 222

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The hazvongel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The hazvongel makes three Talon attacks.

action.name: Talon
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Blood Barrage (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The hazvongel launches a spray of blood in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Hertilod
monster.resist: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 223

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
trait.text: If the hertilod fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The hertilod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shock Susceptibility
trait.text: If the hertilod takes lightning damage, its speed is halved until the end of its next turn, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or immediately regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The hertilod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The hertilod makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the hertilod. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hertilod. At the start of each of the hertilod's turns, each swallowed creature takes 13 (2d12) poison damage from the poisonous secretion in the hertilod's gullet.
The hertilod's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the hertilod takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the hertilod must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition. If the hertilod dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The Hertilod can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Hertilod regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Sprint
legendary.text: The hertilod moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The hertilod drains life from the creatures in its gullet to bolster itself. Each creature in the hertilod's gullet takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the hertilod regains a number of hit points equal to the damage.

monster.name: Kakkuu Spyder-Fiend
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 234

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The kakkuu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The kakkuu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
trait.text: When in contact with a web, the kakkuu knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: The kakkuu ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The kakkuu makes a Web Snare attack, uses Reel, and makes a Bite attack.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Reel
action.text: The kakkuu pulls each creature within 60 feet of itself that is grappled by its Web Snare up to 30 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Web Snare
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 13). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. A web snare grappling a creature can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 10 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

monster.name: Mirror Shade
monster.resist: acid, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: blinded, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 226

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: If the mirror shade is within 5 feet of a reflective surface—such as a mirror, glass pane, or still water—it has advantage on its initiative roll. If a creature hasn't observed the mirror shade move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the mirror shade isn't the creature's own reflection.

trait.name: Mirror Movement
trait.text: The mirror shade can move along the surface of reflective or translucent objects, such as mirrors, without provoking opportunity attacks. It can move through translucent objects as if they were difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The mirror shade makes two Phantasmal Strike attacks and uses Reflect Fear.

action.name: Phantasmal Strike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) radiant damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Reflect Fear
action.text: The mirror shade targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself and projects an illusion of that creature's greatest fear. The target must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the mirror shade's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

action.name: Mirror Stealth (bonus action)
action.text: While within 5 feet of a reflective surface, such as a mirror, the mirror shade takes the Hide action.

monster.name: Moonlight Guardian
monster.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monster.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 227

trait.name: Immutable Form
trait.text: The guardian is immune to any spell or other effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Radiant Absorption
trait.text: Whenever the guardian is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The guardian makes two Moonlight Slam attacks.

action.name: Moonlight Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Moonlight Blast (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The guardian unleashes a magical blast of moonlight in a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. Creatures that aren't in their true form have disadvantage on the save. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (5d8) radiant damage, and if it isn't in its true form, it is forced into its true form and can't change forms until the end of the guardian's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

monster.name: Phisarazu Spyder-Fiend
monster.resist: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 235

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The phisarazu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The phisarazu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
trait.text: When in contact with a web, the phisarazu knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: The phisarazu ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The phisarazu makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Scintillating Spray if available.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage, and the target has the poisoned condition until the start of the phisarazu's next turn.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Scintillating Spray (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The phisarazu expels shimmering webs in a 60-foot cone. Creatures and objects in that area are outlined by the glittering webs for 1 minute, during which time they emit dim light for 10 feet and can't benefit from the invisible condition. Additionally, creatures in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Change Shape (bonus action)
action.text: The phisarazu transforms into a crab, drider, or giant crab, or returns to its true form. Its game statistics, except for its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monster.name: Quavilithku Spyder-Fiend
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 236

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The quavilithku has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The quavilithku can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
trait.text: When in contact with a web, the quavilithku knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: The quavilithku ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The quavilithku makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature can't regain hit points. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Dissolving Web (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The quavilithku expels acid-drenched webs in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Nonmagical objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried take 44 (8d10) acid damage.

action.name: Assess Weakness (bonus action)
action.text: The quavilithku sizes up a creature it can see within 40 feet of itself. Until the start of the quavilithku's next turn, it has advantage on attack rolls against the creature.

monster.name: Raklupis Spyder-Fiend
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 236

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The raklupis has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The raklupis can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
trait.text: When in contact with a web, the raklupis knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: The raklupis ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The raklupis makes a Bite attack and two Serrated Sword attacks. It can use Venom Globe in place of one of these attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature has the incapacitated condition and can't regain hit points. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Serrated Sword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

action.name: Venom Globe
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (10d8) poison damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The raklupis casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20).
• At will: Disguise Self, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Minor Illusion • 2/Day each: Darkness, Dominate Monster, Mass Suggestion, Telekinesis, Teleport

action.name: Demand Loyalty (bonus action)
action.text: The raklupis magically ends the charmed and frightened conditions on itself and on any number of allies within 60 feet of itself.

monster.spells: disguise self, invisibility, mage hand, minor illusion, darkness, dominate monster, mass suggestion, telekinesis, teleport

monster.name: Relentless Impaler
monster.languages: understands all languages but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 231

trait.name: Bloodheart Stake
trait.text: The impaler is magically bound to the ceremonial stake and the sacrificed corpse the ritual caster used to create it. If the impaler is reduced to 0 hit points, it disappears, then re-forms 1d8 hours later in the nearest unoccupied space to the stake and regains all its hit points. The impaler dies only if it is reduced to 0 hit points while either the ceremonial stake is removed from the sacrifice's corpse or the impaler is on a different plane of existence from that corpse.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the impaler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The impaler makes one Spike attack and two Wicked Spear attacks.

action.name: Spike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the impaler's next turn.

action.name: Wicked Spear
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Spike Burst (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Twisted, spectral spikes shoot out from the impaler's body. Each creature within 30 feet of the impaler must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The Relentless Impaler can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Relentless Impaler regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Speed Spike
legendary.text: The impaler teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It can then make a Spike attack.

legendary.name: Deepen Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Each creature whose speed is currently reduced by the impaler's Spike attack takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

monster.name: Spiderdragon
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 233

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The spiderdragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The spiderdragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: The spiderdragon ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The spiderdragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Spiderling Breath (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: The spiderdragon exhales venomous spiderlings in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) piercing damage and 33 (6d10) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Stifling Webs (Recharge 5-6) (bonus action)
action.text:
The spiderdragon spins a 30-foot cube of strong, sticky webbing in an area adjacent to itself. The webbing lasts for 1 minute, is difficult terrain, and lightly obscures its area. A creature that starts its turn in the webbing or enters the webbing for the first time on its turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the restrained condition while in the web. As an action, a creature can free itself or another creature from the web by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check.
A 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 10 acid, fire, or slashing damage on a single turn.

monster.name: Star Angler
monster.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (can't see beyond this radius)
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 237

trait.name: Avoidance
trait.text: If the star angler is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Illumination
trait.text: The star angler's lure sheds bright light in a 30- foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The star angler makes three Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Lure Charm (bonus action)
action.text: The star angler's lure flares with enchanting starlight, targeting one creature the star angler can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of the star angler's next turn. While charmed in this way, the target has the incapacitated condition and must use its movement on its turn to move directly toward the star angler; a charmed target doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but it does avoid damaging terrain. A target can be charmed by only one star angler at a time.

monster.name: Vlazok
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 238

trait.name: All-Around Vision
trait.text: The vlazok can't be surprised.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
trait.text: The vlazok has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The vlazok has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The vlazok can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The vlazok makes two Gore attacks.

action.name: Gore
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the prone condition.

action.name: Stomp (bonus action)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Warforged Warrior
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 238

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The warforged makes two Armblade attacks.

action.name: Armblade
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Protection
reaction.text: When an attacker the warforged can see makes an attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of the warforged, the warforged can impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

monster.name: Whirling Chandelier
monster.conditionImmune: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 239

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: If the chandelier is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the chandelier move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the chandelier is animate.

trait.name: Fiery Aura
trait.text: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the chandelier takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The chandelier makes three Chain attacks, three Lamp attacks, or a combination thereof.

action.name: Chain
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the chandelier.

action.name: Lamp
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

action.name: Blazing Vortex (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Each creature within 20 feet of the chandelier and not behind total cover must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) fire damage and have the blinded condition until the start of the chandelier's next turn.

monster.name: Alustriel Silverhand
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 242

trait.name: Special Equipment
trait.text: Alustriel carries a magic staff known as the Staff of Silverymoon. In the hands of anyone other than Alustriel, the Staff of Silverymoon is a Staff of Power.

trait.name: Ear of the Chosen
trait.text: Whenever a creature on the same plane of existence as Alustriel speaks Alustriel's name, Alustriel hears her name and the next nine words the speaker utters.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Alustriel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Alustriel makes three Staff of Silverymoon attacks or two Reproving Ray attacks.

action.name: Staff of Silverymoon
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 38 (7d10) radiant damage.

action.name: Reproving Ray
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +14 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 65 (9d12 + 7) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the incapacitated condition until the start of Alustriel's next turn. On a successful save, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of Alustriel's next turn.

action.name: Argent Blaze (Requires Silver Fire)
action.text: Alustriel summons a 60- foot cone of silver fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 77 (14d10) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
