Additionally, Alustriel or one creature of her choice within 60 feet of her then regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Alustriel casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):
• At will: Dancing Lights, Detect Magic, Mage Armor (self only), Mage Hand • 2/Day each: Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Tongues • 1/Day each: Telepathy, Teleport, Time Stop

action.name: Silver Fire (2/Day) (bonus action)
action.text: Brilliant silver fire harmlessly wreathes Alustriel and empowers her. The silver fire lasts for 1 hour or until she has the incapacitated condition or uses another bonus action to quench it. While wreathed in silver fire, Alustriel gains truesight within 30 feet and can use her Argent Blaze action. In addition, Alustriel is unaffected by magic that would ascertain her alignment, creature type, thoughts, or truthfulness.

reaction.name: Shining Counterspell
reaction.text: Alustriel interrupts a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 5th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 6th level or higher, Alustriel makes an Intelligence check (DC 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 11 (2d10) radiant damage if the spell fails.

monster.spells: dancing lights, detect magic, mage armor, mage hand, detect thoughts, dispel magic, tongues, telepathy, teleport, time stop

monster.name: Argentia Skywright
monster.ac: 11 (in humanoid form, 12 natural armor in wolf or hybrid form)
monster.immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text: Argentia can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
trait.text: Argentia has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Argentia makes two attacks: two with its spear (humanoid form) or one with its bite and one with its claws (hybrid form).

action.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

action.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monster.name: Camlash
monster.resist: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 181

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: Camlash explodes when reduced to 0 hit points, and each creature within 30 feet of Camlash must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Camlash has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Aura
trait.text: Camlash is surrounded by tiny biting spiders that magically appear and disappear from moment to moment. At the start of each of Camlash's turns, each creature within 10 feet of Camlash takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the start of Camlash's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Camlash makes one Flaming Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack. Camlash can replace one of these attacks with Teleport.

action.name: Flaming Whip
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) fire damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Camlash.

action.name: Lightning Blade
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Teleport
action.text: Camlash magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

monster.name: Crunch
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: Crunch has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Crunch's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Crunch makes three Armblade or Bolt Launcher attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Snare Trap.

action.name: Armblade
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Bolt Launcher
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Snare Trap (1/Day)
action.text: Crunch deploys a Tiny mechanical trap on a solid surface within 5 feet of itself. The trap is hidden, requiring a successful DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to find. The trap lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an enemy enters a space within 10 feet of the trap or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and have the prone condition. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.

action.name: Dash (bonus action)
action.text: Crunch moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

monster.name: Eldon Keyward
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Divine Eminence
trait.text: As a bonus action, Eldon can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Eldon expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

action.name: Mace
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Eldon is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Eldon has the following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy • 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary • 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon • 3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians

monster.spells: light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy, cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary, lesser restoration, spiritual weapon, dispel magic, spirit guardians

monster.name: Fernitha
monster.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Hellish Weapons
trait.text: Fernitha's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) poison damage on a hit (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Fernitha has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Fernitha makes three attacks.

action.name: Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

action.name: Longbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. The poison lasts until it is removed by the lesser restoration spell or similar magic.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Fernitha adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Fernitha must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Figaro
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Figaro is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Figaro has the following wizard spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation • 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield • 2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion • 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly • 4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm • 5th level (1 slots): cone of cold

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.spells: fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield, misty step, suggestion, counterspell, fireball, fly, greater invisibility, ice storm, cone of cold, thaumaturgy, darkness, hellish rebuke

monster.name: Glaive
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 81

trait.name: Heatsink
trait.text: When Glaive takes cold damage, her Overdrive immediately recharges.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: Glaive has advantage on attack rolls if at least one ally is within 5 feet of the creature she's attacking and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Glaive makes two Spiked Glaive attacks and two Serrated Bolt attacks.

action.name: Spiked Glaive
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing or slashing damage, or 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing or slashing damage if Glaive is in overdrive.

action.name: Serrated Bolt
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage. If Glaive has advantage on the attack roll, the serrated bolt lodges in the target, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the serrated bolt is removed. A target's speed can be reduced by only one serrated bolt at a time. A creature can use its action to remove a serrated bolt lodged in itself or another creature within its reach; when the bolt is removed from a creature, that creature takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

action.name: Overdrive (Recharges after Finishing a Short or Long Rest) (bonus action)
action.text:
Glaive enters a state of overdrive that lasts for 1 minute or until she has the incapacitated condition. While in overdrive, Glaive gains the following benefits:
• Glaive has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. • Glaive makes a melee weapon attack, she gains a +4 bonus to the damage roll. • Glaive's speed increases to 50 feet.

reaction.name: Self-Preservation
reaction.text: In response to being hit by a weapon attack, Glaive reduces the damage by 11 (2d10).

monster.name: Grottenelle Stonecutter
monster.languages: any four languages, Gnomish, Terran, Undercommon
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
trait.text: Grottenelle has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
trait.text: Grottenelle has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Grottenelle's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14). Grottenelle can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: nondetection (self only) • 1/Day each: blindness/deafness, blur, disguise self

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Grottenelle is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Grottenelle has the following wizard spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation • 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield • 2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion • 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly • 4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm • 5th level (1 slots): cone of cold

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.spells: fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield, misty step, suggestion, counterspell, fireball, fly, greater invisibility, ice storm, cone of cold, nondetection, blindness/deafness, blur, disguise self

monster.name: Inda
monster.resist: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
trait.text: Inda's weapon attacks are magical. When Inda hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Inda has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Inda's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). Inda can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:
• At will: detect evil and good • 1/Day each: commune, raise dead

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Inda makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Mace
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
action.text: Inda touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

action.name: Change Shape
action.text:
Inda magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Inda's choice).
In a new form, Inda retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

monster.spells: detect evil and good, commune, raise dead

monster.name: Indrina Lamsensettle
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

reaction.name: Parry
reaction.text: Indrina adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Indrina must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Jerot Galgin
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Jerot makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

action.name: Arcane Burst
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Jerot casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
• At will: dancing lights, mage hand, prestidigitation • 2/Day each: bestow curse, dimension door, mage armor, web • 1/Day each: circle of death

action.name: Summon Undead (1/Day) (bonus action)
action.text: Jerot magically summons five skeleton or zombie. The summoned creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of Jerot, whom they obey. They take their turns immediately after Jerot. Each lasts for 1 hour, until it or Jerot dies, or until Jerot dismisses it as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Grim Harvest (1/Turn)
reaction.text: When Jerot kills a creature with necrotic damage, Jerot regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

monster.spells: dancing lights, mage hand, prestidigitation, bestow curse, dimension door, mage armor, web, circle of death

monster.name: Kas the Betrayer
monster.immune: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 244

trait.name: Special Equipment
trait.text: Kas wears the Crown of Lies (see the Introduction of Vecna: Eve of Ruin).

trait.name: Eager Betrayer
trait.text: Kas adds 1d10 to his initiative rolls. He has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has the frightened condition.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Kas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Kas regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: Kas can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Strength of the Night
trait.text: Kas doesn't require a coffin, and he drinks blood to sow terror rather than for sustenance. If destroyed, Kas revives in 1d100 nights in an unoccupied space in Tovag, his Domain of Dread. He can be permanently destroyed only by having a stake driven through his heart and then being beheaded. The stake must be cut from a tree growing in soil from Oerth, Kas's home world.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Kas takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Kas makes three Vengeful Sword attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with a Bite attack.

action.name: Vengeful Sword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d8 + 11) slashing damage. The sword scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Kas regains a number of hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Kas's control.

action.name: Change Shape (bonus action)
action.text: Kas transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Kas has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Kas can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. Kas has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage except the damage he takes as part of his Vampire Weaknesses trait. While in mist form, Kas can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

action.name: Menacing Glare (bonus action)
action.text: Kas targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of Kas's next turn.

reaction.name: Parrying Riposte
reaction.text: Kas adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack roll that would hit him. He then makes one Vengeful Sword attack against the attacker if it is within his reach. On a hit, the target takes an additional 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Kas the Betrayer can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Kas the Betrayer regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Move
legendary.text: Kas moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Sword (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Kas makes one Vengeful Sword attack.

legendary.name: Rise, Fallen Soldier (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Kas magically summons a specter. The specter appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kas, whom it obeys. The specter takes its turn immediately after Kas. It lasts for 1 hour, until Kas dies, or until Kas dismisses it as a bonus action. Kas can't have more than two specters summoned at a time.

monster.name: Kaylan Renaudon
monster.resist: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.languages: the languages it knew in life
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text:
If Kaylan isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.
While in bat form, Kaylan can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
While in mist form, Kaylan can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Kaylan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
trait.text:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, Kaylan transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.
While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Kaylan regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Kaylan takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Kaylan's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: Kaylan can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
trait.text:
Kaylan has the following flaws:
Forbiddance. Kaylan can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water. Kaylan takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Kaylan's heart while Kaylan is incapacitated in its resting place, Kaylan is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Kaylan takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
action.text: Kaylan makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Kaylan can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by Kaylan, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Kaylan regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Kaylan's control.

action.name: Charm
action.text:
Kaylan targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Kaylan, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by Kaylan. The charmed target regards Kaylan as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Kaylan's control, it takes Kaylan's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Kaylan's bite attack.
Each time Kaylan or Kaylan's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Kaylan is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
action.text: Kaylan magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats or swarm of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Kaylan can call 3d6 wolf instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Kaylan and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Kaylan dies, or until Kaylan dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Kaylan Renaudon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Kaylan Renaudon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Move
legendary.text: Kaylan moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary.text: Kaylan makes one unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Kaylan makes one bite attack.

monster.name: Ker-Arach
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Ker-arach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: Ker-arach can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: Ker-arach ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Ker-arach makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Spiderling Breath (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Ker-arach exhales venomous spiderlings in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) piercing damage and 33 (6d10) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Stifling Webs (Recharge 5-6) (bonus action)
action.text:
Ker-arach spins a 30-foot cube of strong, sticky webbing in an area adjacent to itself. The webbing lasts for 1 minute, is difficult terrain, and lightly obscures its area. A creature that starts its turn in the webbing or enters the webbing for the first time on its turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the restrained condition while in the web. As an action, a creature can free itself or another creature from the web by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check.
A 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 10 acid, fire, or slashing damage on a single turn.

monster.name: Kevetta Dolindar
monster.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Psychic Leech
trait.text: At the start of each of Kevetta's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

trait.name: Thrives on Company
trait.text: Kevetta has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Kevetta makes one Harpoon Arm attack, and it uses Sorrowful Embrace.

action.name: Harpoon Arm
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Kevetta has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

action.name: Sorrowful Embrace
action.text: Each creature grappled by Kevetta must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, Kevetta pulls each of those creatures up to 30 feet straight toward it.

monster.name: Khai Kiroth
monster.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Khai's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Khai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Khai makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Frightful Presence or Incite Fanaticism.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) force damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
action.text: Each creature of Khai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of Khai must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Khai's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Incite Fanaticism
action.text: Khai chooses up to four other creatures within 60 feet of it that can see it. Until the start of Khai's next turn, each of those creatures makes attack rolls with advantage and can't be frightened.

action.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
action.text: Khai targets one Dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. The Dragon must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. A chromatic dragon makes this save with disadvantage. On a successful save, the target is immune to Khai's Power of the Dragon Queen for 1 hour. On a failed save, the target is charmed by Khai for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the target regards Khai as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. This effect ends if Khai or its companions deal damage to the target.

monster.name: Laysa Matulin
monster.languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Assassinate
trait.text: During its first turn, Laysa has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Laysa scores against a Surprise creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Evasion
trait.text: If Laysa is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Laysa instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
trait.text: Laysa deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Laysa that isn't incapacitated and Laysa doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Laysa makes two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Light Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Lysan
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
trait.text:
Lysan's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• At will: mage hand (the hand is invisible) • 3/Day each: jump, misty step, nondetection (self only), tongues • 1/Day each: plane shift, telekinesis

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Lysan makes two silver greatsword attacks.

action.name: Silver Greatsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. This is a magic weapon attack. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body (as with the astral projection spell), Lysan can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body, instead of dealing damage.

monster.spells: mage hand, jump, misty step, nondetection, tongues, plane shift, telekinesis

monster.name: Malaina van Talstiv
monster.languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Assassinate
trait.text: During its first turn, Malaina has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Malaina scores against a Surprise creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Evasion
trait.text: If Malaina is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Malaina instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
trait.text: Malaina deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Malaina that isn't incapacitated and Malaina doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Malaina makes two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Light Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Miska the Wolf-Spider
monster.immune: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 247

trait.name: Foul Ichor
trait.text: A creature that hits Miska with a melee weapon attack takes 7 (2d6) poison damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Miska fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Miska has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: Miska can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
trait.text: When in contact with a web, Miska knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: Miska ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Miska makes one Lupine Bite attack and two Trident of Chaos attacks.

action.name: Lupine Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature has the incapacitated condition and can't regain hit points. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Trident of Chaos
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Miska casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21):
• At will: Disguise Self, Invisibility, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Web • 2/Day each: Dominate Monster, Mass Suggestion, Mirror Image, Telekinesis, Teleport

action.name: Demand Loyalty (bonus action)
action.text: Miska magically ends the charmed and frightened conditions on himself and on any of his allies within 120 feet of himself.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Miska the Wolf-Spider can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Miska the Wolf-Spider regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Howl
legendary.text: Miska utters a bloodthirsty howl at one creature within 120 feet of himself that isn't a Fiend. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or take 13 (2d12) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Skitter
legendary.text: Miska moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Miska uses Spellcasting.

monster.spells: disguise self, invisibility, mage hand, minor illusion, web, dominate monster, mass suggestion, mirror image, telekinesis, teleport

monster.name: Naxa
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Naxa has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Naxa to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Naxa has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Naxa's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: dancing lights • 1/Day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)

action.name: Staff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
action.text: Naxa magically summons a quasit, or attempts to summon a shadow demon with a 50 chance of success. The summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

monster.spells: dancing lights, darkness, faerie fire, levitate, mage hand, minor illusion, poison spray, ray of frost, mage armor, magic missile, shield, witch bolt, alter self, misty step, web, fly, lightning bolt, evard's black tentacles, greater invisibility, cloudkill

monster.name: Nyssa Otellion
monster.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Nyssa's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Nyssa has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Nyssa makes three Bite or Lightning Strike attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Strike
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (8d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Nyssa casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
• At will: disguise self, mage hand, minor illusion • 2/Day each: charm person, dispel magic, greater invisibility, wall of force

action.name: Teleport (bonus action)
action.text: Nyssa teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see.

monster.spells: disguise self, mage hand, minor illusion, charm person, dispel magic, greater invisibility, wall of force

monster.name: Orinix
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
trait.text: If Orinix fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Tunneler
trait.text: Orinix can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 15-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: Orinix doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Orinix makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Orinix exhales a blast of frost in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

action.name: Phase (3/Day) (bonus action)
action.text: Orinix becomes partially incorporeal for as long as it maintains concentration on the effect (as if concentration on a spell). While partially incorporeal, Orinix has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Orinix can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Orinix regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
legendary.text: Orinix makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Treacherous Ice
legendary.text: Magical ice covers the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point Orinix can see within 120 feet of itself. The ice, which is difficult terrain for all creatures except lunar dragons, lasts for 10 minutes or until Orinix uses this legendary action again.

monster.name: Rack
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: Crunch has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Crunch's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Crunch makes three Armblade or Bolt Launcher attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Snare Trap.

action.name: Armblade
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Bolt Launcher
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Snare Trap (1/Day)
action.text: Crunch deploys a Tiny mechanical trap on a solid surface within 5 feet of itself. The trap is hidden, requiring a successful DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to find. The trap lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an enemy enters a space within 10 feet of the trap or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and have the prone condition. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.

action.name: Dash (bonus action)
action.text: Crunch moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

monster.name: Redbud
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: While Redbud remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Siege Monster
trait.text: Redbud deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Redbud makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
action.text: Redbud magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as a treant, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of Redbud. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until Redbud dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until Redbud takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

monster.name: Rerak
monster.immune: necrotic, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned
monster.languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Giant, Infernal, Primordial, Undercommon
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Rerak fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Rerak has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Rerak makes two Death Rend attacks and uses Bloodcurdling Lament if available.

action.name: Death Rend
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

action.name: Bloodcurdling Lament (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Rerak emits a hideous shriek charged with malignant energy. Each creature within 30 feet of Rerak must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature also has the unconscious condition. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Rerak casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):
• At will: Detect Magic, Fly, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation • 3/Day each: Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only) • 1/Day each: Globe of Invulnerability, Hold Monster

action.name: Soul Siphon (bonus action)
action.text:
Rerak targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw; if the target has the unconscious condition, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. The target takes 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Rerak then regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of force damage taken.
If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target immediately dies, its body disappears, and its soul is trapped inside one of the soul gems within Rerak's skull. After 24 hours, the gem transfers the soul to Rerak's creator.
When Rerak is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and disintegrates, leaving behind the gems. Crushing a gem releases any souls trapped within, at which point the soul's body re-forms in an unoccupied space nearest to the gem and in the same state as it was when its soul was trapped.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Rerak can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Rerak regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Spiteful Teleport
legendary.text: Rerak, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of itself. It then makes one Death Rend attack if possible.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Rerak uses Spellcasting.

monster.spells: detect magic, fly, mage hand, prestidigitation, dispel magic, invisibility, globe of invulnerability, hold monster

monster.name: Rezran "Snake Eyes" Agrodro
monster.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Rezran's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Rezran has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Rezran makes two Fiendish Claw attacks, or it makes one Fiendish Claw attack and uses Spellcasting.

action.name: Fiendish Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Rezran casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
• At will: alter self, major image • 3/Day each: charm person, detect thoughts, fear • 1/Day each: confusion, dominate person, mass suggestion

monster.spells: alter self, major image, charm person, detect thoughts, fear, confusion, dominate person, mass suggestion

monster.name: Riffel
monster.ac: 11 (in humanoid form, 12 natural armor in wolf or hybrid form)
monster.immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text: Riffel can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
trait.text: Riffel has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Riffel makes two attacks: two with its spear (humanoid form) or one with its bite and one with its claws (hybrid form).

action.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

action.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monster.name: Sangora
monster.resist: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.languages: the languages it knew in life
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text:
If Sangora isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.
While in bat form, Sangora can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
While in mist form, Sangora can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Sangora fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
trait.text:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, Sangora transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.
While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Sangora regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Sangora takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Sangora's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: Sangora can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
trait.text:
Sangora has the following flaws:
Forbiddance. Sangora can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water. Sangora takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Sangora's heart while Sangora is incapacitated in its resting place, Sangora is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Sangora takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
action.text: Sangora makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Sangora can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by Sangora, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Sangora regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Sangora's control.

action.name: Charm
action.text:
Sangora targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Sangora, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by Sangora. The charmed target regards Sangora as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Sangora's control, it takes Sangora's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Sangora's bite attack.
Each time Sangora or Sangora's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Sangora is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
action.text: Sangora magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats or swarm of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Sangora can call 3d6 wolf instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Sangora and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Sangora dies, or until Sangora dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Sangora can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Sangora regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Move
legendary.text: Sangora moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary.text: Sangora makes one unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Sangora makes one bite attack.

monster.name: Sarcelle Malinosh
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.name: Sarusanda Allester
monster.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, any four languages, telepathy 120 ft.
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Sarusanda attacks twice.

action.name: Force Bolt
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) force damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, Sarusanda can push it up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Silver Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

action.name: Implode (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Sarusanda can see within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 31 (6d8 + 4) force damage and be knocked prone and moved to the unoccupied space closest to the sphere's center. Large and smaller objects that aren't being worn or carried in the sphere automatically take the damage and are similarly moved.

action.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
Sarusanda casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
• At will: detect magic, dispel magic, levitate, mage armor, mage hand, sending, speak with dead • 1/Day each: Otiluke's resilient sphere, telekinesis

reaction.name: Telekinetic Deflection
reaction.text: In response to being hit by an attack roll, Sarusanda increases its AC by 4 against the attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the attacker is hit by the attack instead.

monster.spells: detect magic, dispel magic, levitate, mage armor, mage hand, sending, speak with dead, otiluke's resilient sphere, telekinesis

monster.name: Shanzezim
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: Shanzezim can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Elemental Demise
trait.text: If Shanzezim dies, its body disintegrates into a burst of water and foam, leaving behind only equipment Shanzezim was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Shanzezim's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: create or destroy water, detect evil and good, detect magic, fog cloud, purify food and drink • 3/Day each: tongues, water breathing, water walk • 1/Day each: conjure elemental (water elemental only), control water, gaseous form, invisibility, plane shift

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Shanzezim makes two trident attacks.

action.name: Trident
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage, or 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Water Jet
action.text: Shanzezim magically shoots water in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, is pushed up to 20 feet away from Shanzezim and knocked prone. On a success, a target takes half the bludgeoning damage, but is neither pushed nor knocked prone.

monster.spells: create or destroy water, detect evil and good, detect magic, fog cloud, purify food and drink, tongues, water breathing, water walk, conjure elemental, control water, gaseous form, invisibility, plane shift

monster.name: Strahd, Master of Death House
monster.resist: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Giant, Infernal
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 251

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Strahd fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Master of the House
trait.text: When Strahd is reduced to 0 hit points, he dissolves into mist and immediately teleports to his lair in Castle Ravenloft. After 1d4 hours, Strahd re-forms in a random unoccupied space within his lair, regaining all his hit points.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Strahd regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: Strahd can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
trait.text:
Strahd has the following flaws:
Forbiddance. Strahd can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water. While in running water, Strahd takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn there, and he can't use his Change Shape.
Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Strahd's heart while Strahd is incapacitated in its resting place, Strahd is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. While in sunlight, Strahd takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Strahd makes two Death Strike attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with Blighted Fire if available.

action.name: Death Strike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, Strahd can forgo dealing slashing damage; the target then has the grappled condition (escape DC 18) instead. Strahd can grapple only one creature at a time.

action.name: Blighted Fire (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Strahd summons shadowy, necrotic fire that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 90 feet of himself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Charm
action.text:
Strahd targets one Humanoid he can see within 30 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition. The charmed target regards Strahd as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. The target isn't under Strahd's control, but it takes Strahd's requests and actions in the most favorable way.
Each time Strahd or his companions deal damage to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Strahd is reduced to 0 hit points, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or uses a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Strahd casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
• At will: Detect Thoughts, Fog Cloud, Mage Hand • 2/Day each: Animate Dead (as an action), Gust of Wind, Mirror Image, Nondetection • 1/Day each: Greater Invisibility, Polymorph, Scrying (as an action)

action.name: Bite (bonus action)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that has the charmed or grappled condition. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Strahd regains a number of hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Strahd's control.

action.name: Change Shape (bonus action)
action.text:
Strahd transforms into a new form or back into his true form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies. When transforming into a new form, Strahd chooses one of the following options:
Beast Form: Strahd transforms into a Tiny bat (flying speed 30 ft.) or a Medium wolf (speed 40 ft.). While in that form, he can't speak, and he retains his game statistics other than his size and speed.
Mist Form: Strahd transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Strahd has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Strahd can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. Strahd has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage except the damage he takes as part of his Vampire Weaknesses trait. While in mist form, Strahd can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Strahd, Master of Death House can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Strahd, Master of Death House regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Cunning Escape
legendary.text: Strahd moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Strahd makes one Death Strike attack.

monster.spells: detect thoughts, fog cloud, mage hand, animate dead, gust of wind, mirror image, nondetection, greater invisibility, polymorph, scrying

monster.name: Tasha the Witch
monster.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 252

trait.name: Special Equipment
trait.text: Tasha wears a Robe of the Archmagi.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Tasha fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Tasha has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. (This trait is bestowed by her Robe of the Archmagi.)

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Tasha makes two Caustic Blast attacks and uses Psychic Whip once.

action.name: Caustic Blast
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d4 + 6) acid damage.

action.name: Psychic Whip
action.text: Tasha psychically lashes out at one creature she can see within 90 feet of herself. The target must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and has the stunned condition until the start of Tasha's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text: Tasha casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks):
• At will: Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Dispel Magic, Light, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation, Tasha's Hideous Laughter
• 2/Day: Polymorph
• 1/Day each: Maze, Telekinesis

action.name: Abyssal Visage (2/Day) (bonus action)
action.text: For 1 minute, Tasha gains a flying speed of 30 feet, is immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition, and has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points. These benefits end early if Tasha has the incapacitated condition or if she uses another bonus action to dismiss them.

reaction.name: Arcane Rebuff
reaction.text: Immediately after Tasha takes damage, she unleashes arcane energy in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on herself. All other creatures in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d12) lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Tasha then teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet of herself.

monster.spells: detect magic, disguise self, dispel magic, light, mage hand, message, prestidigitation, tasha's hideous laughter, polymorph, maze, telekinesis

monster.name: Teremini Nightsedge
monster.resist: damage from spells; nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing (from stoneskin)
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Teremini has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Teremini is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Teremini can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
• At will: disguise self, invisibility • Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp • 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, mage armor*, magic missile • 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step • 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fly, lightning bolt • 4th level (3 slots): banishment, fire shield, stoneskin* • 5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, scrying, wall of force • 6th level (1 slots): globe of invulnerability • 7th level (1 slots): teleport • 8th level (1 slots): mind blank* • 9th level (1 slots): time stop
*Teremini casts these spells on itself before combat.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.spells: disguise self, invisibility, fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp, detect magic, identify, mage armor, magic missile, detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step, counterspell, fly, lightning bolt, banishment, fire shield, stoneskin, cone of cold, scrying, wall of force, globe of invulnerability, teleport, mind blank, time stop

monster.name: Umberto Noblin
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monster.name: Uvashar
monster.immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
trait.text: Uvashar can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Uvashar makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is cursed if it is a creature. The magical curse takes effect whenever the target takes a short or long rest, filling the target's thoughts with horrible images and dreams. The cursed target gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

monster.name: Vaeve
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: Vaeve has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Vaeve to sleep.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Vaeve's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• At will: dancing lights • 1/Day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
Vaeve is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Vaeve has the following wizard spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): mage hand, minor illusion, poison spray, ray of frost • 1st level (4 slots): mage armor, magic missile, shield, witch bolt • 2nd level (3 slots): alter self, misty step, web • 3rd level (3 slots): fly, lightning bolt • 4th level (3 slots): Evard's black tentacles, greater invisibility • 5th level (2 slots): cloudkill

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, Vaeve has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Staff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
action.text: Vaeve magically summons a quasit, or attempts to summon a shadow demon with a 50 chance of success. The summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

monster.spells: dancing lights, darkness, faerie fire, levitate, mage hand, minor illusion, poison spray, ray of frost, mage armor, magic missile, shield, witch bolt, alter self, misty step, web, fly, lightning bolt, evard's black tentacles, greater invisibility, cloudkill

monster.name: Valendar
monster.ac: 11 (in humanoid form, 12 natural armor in wolf or hybrid form)
monster.immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text: Valendar can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
trait.text: Valendar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Valendar makes two attacks: two with its spear (humanoid form) or one with its bite and one with its claws (hybrid form).

action.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

action.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monster.name: Vecna the Archlich
monster.immune: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned
monster.description: Source: Vecna: Eve of Ruin p. 254

trait.name: Special Equipment
trait.text: Vecna carries a magic dagger named Afterthought. In the hands of anyone other than Vecna, Afterthought is a +2 Dagger.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
trait.text: If Vecna fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Undying
trait.text: If Vecna is slain, his soul refuses to accept its fate and lives on as a disembodied spirit that fashions a new body for itself after 1d100 years. Vecna's new body appears within 100 miles of where he was slain. When the new body is complete, Vecna regains all his hit points and becomes active again.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Vecna uses Flight of the Damned (if available), Rotten Fate, or Spellcasting. He then makes two attacks with Afterthought.

action.name: Afterthought
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is afflicted by entropic magic, taking 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Immediately after taking this damage on its turn, the target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Until it succeeds on this save, the afflicted target can't regain hit points.

action.name: Flight of the Damned (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Vecna conjures a torrent of flying, spectral entities that fill a 120-foot cone and pass through all creatures in that area before dissipating. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Rotten Fate
